paras.en: That unpredictability is one of the main contributing factors to those notable recent polling misses, even if the margins in most reputable polls were only off by a few percentage points.
paras.zh: 这种不可预测性是导致近期民意调查明显失误的主要因素之一，即使大多数知名民意调查的利润率仅下降了几个百分点。

paras.en: In a close race, those few points can make the difference between victory and defeat for a candidate. And this year, many of the key Senate races are within those narrow margins.
paras.zh: 在接近的比赛中，这几分可以决定候选人的胜负。今年，许多关键的参议院竞选都在这些狭窄的利润范围内。

paras.en: In recent years, midterm general election polls have proven to be more accurate, in part because Trump - and his unique ability to draw disaffected Americans to the polls - was not on the ballot.
paras.zh: 近年来，中期大选民意调查被证明更准确，部分原因是特朗普-以及他吸引不满的美国人参加民意调查的独特能力-不在选票上。

paras.en: In 2022, they suggested Democrats would defy conventional expectations and avoid an electoral wipe-out despite Biden's low approval numbers.
paras.zh: 2022年，他们表示，尽管拜登的支持率很低，但民主党人将无视传统的期望，避免选举被淘汰。

paras.en: While the party lost control of the House of Representatives, the margins were slim and Democrats maintained control of the US Senate.
paras.zh: 虽然该党失去了对众议院的控制权，但利润微薄，民主党保持了对美国参议院的控制权。

paras.en: While this year's primary results did provide bigger surprises, Young says that nominating contests have historically been volatile, with voters more likely to make up their minds at the last minute. It shouldn't be seen as an indication that the current crop of general election polls are off the mark.
paras.zh: 虽然今年的主要结果确实带来了更大的惊喜，但Young表示，提名竞赛历史上一直不稳定，选民更有可能在最后一刻做出决定。这不应该被视为当前大选民意调查数量偏离正轨的迹象。

paras.en: It's common for the party of the president to have a bad night in the midterms.
paras.zh: 总统的政党在中期选举中经常会有一个糟糕的夜晚。

paras.en: One of the most notable examples in recent years came in 2010 when Republicans flipped more than 60 House seats and made gains in the Senate.
paras.zh: 近年来最着名的例子之一发生在2010年，当时共和党人翻转了60多个众议院席位并在参议院中获胜。

paras.en: It came off the back of an economy struggling to recover from the financial crash and conservative fears over President Barack Obama's healthcare reforms. A defeat had been predicted by the polls but not quite on that scale.
paras.zh: 它源于经济正在努力从金融危机中恢复过来，以及保守派对巴拉克•奥巴马（ Barack Obama ）总统医疗保健改革的担忧。民意调查预测会失败，但规模不大。

paras.en: The roles are reversed this time, with the Democrats in opposition and the economy on the minds of voters. But there are a number of reasons why Democrats may not have as good a night as history might suggest or as some might expect, given Trump's low approval rating.
paras.zh: 这次角色相反，民主党人反对，经济在选民的心目中。但鉴于特朗普的支持率较低，民主党人可能没有像历史所暗示或一些人所期望的那样度过一个美好的夜晚，原因有很多。

paras.en: Firstly, much of the territory in play in this election Trump conquered with ease in the presidential election just two years ago. It's like a home game for Republicans.
paras.zh: 首先，在这次选举中，特朗普在两年前的总统选举中轻松征服了大部分领土。这就像是共和党人的主场比赛。

paras.en: Then there have been changes to House election boundaries over the years that have meant fewer seats switch between parties.
paras.zh: 然后，多年来众议院选举界限发生了变化，这意味着在政党之间切换的席位减少了。

paras.en: Thirdly, there are fewer swing voters due to the deeper polarisation of the country. Some experts describe the electorate as calcified.
paras.zh: 第三，由于该国两极分化加深，摇摆选民较少。一些专家将选民描述为钙化。

paras.en: There's also the cash advantage Republicans have enjoyed which has given them hundreds of millions of dollars to spend on attack ads in the final weeks.
paras.zh: 共和党人也享受到了现金优势，这让他们在最后几周花费了数亿美元用于攻击广告。

paras.en: Polling models try to capture shifting fundamentals. And a well-designed poll is built to anticipate issues that may make it less than reliable.
paras.zh: 民意调查模型试图捕捉不断变化的基本面。精心设计的民意调查旨在预测可能导致其不可靠的问题。

paras.en: Individual polls do have a built-in margin of error â a statistical level of uncertainty based on the sampling size compared to the population as a whole. Taken as an aggregate, polling averages and not individual surveys can provide a more accurate prediction.
paras.zh: 单个民意调查确实具有内置的误差范围-基于与整体人群相比的抽样规模的统计不确定性水平。总体而言，民意调查平均值而不是单个调查可以提供更准确的预测。

paras.en: At the moment, even the kind of polling lean we saw in recent presidential elections would suggest Democrats are likely to have a good night on 3 November. And polling inaccuracies can go both ways. In last year's state and special elections, Democrats outperformed most surveys as it was their voters who turned out in unexpectedly larger numbers.
paras.zh: 目前，即使是我们在最近的总统选举中看到的那种投票倾向，也会表明民主党人可能会在11月3日度过一个美好的夜晚。民意调查的不准确性可能是双向的。在去年的州和特别选举中，民主党人的表现优于大多数调查，因为他们的选民人数出乎意料地多。

paras.en: The sight of Trump holding rallies in the final days of the campaign in states he won comfortably in 2024 will have lifted Democrats' hopes that Republican internal polling has conservative candidates in trouble.
paras.zh: 特朗普在竞选的最后几天在他2024年轻松获胜的州举行集会，这将解除民主党人对共和党内部民意调查使保守派候选人陷入困境的希望。

paras.en: There's always the chance that voters change their minds right up until election day, however.
paras.zh: 然而，在选举日之前，选民总是有可能改变主意。

paras.en: Sometimes there are late shifts that can alter the dynamics of a race. Sometimes undecided voters, which still account for a key segment of the electorate in many of these races, all break the same way.
In polling, there will always be some level of uncertainty â and managing that is the art that goes along with the science.
"I think we're doing a better job," says Young. "But part of the problem we always have is not just with the pollsters. Part of it is that we're dealing with humans. Humans are not easy."

articles.title: Ukraine air raid app apparently hacked as users receive false radiation threat, Air Force says

paras.en: Ukraine's air raid alert app was apparently hacked on Sunday and for a short time said the capital Kyiv was subject to a radiation threat, the Ukrainian Air Force has said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰空军表示，乌克兰的空袭警报应用程序显然在周日遭到黑客攻击，并在短时间内表示首都基辅受到辐射威胁。

paras.en: The alert on Telegram read: "The Air Alarm application has probably been subjected to hostile interference. There is no radiation threat! Stay calm and follow our updates on our channel."
paras.zh: Telegram上的警报显示： “Air Alarm应用程序可能受到了恶意干扰。没有辐射威胁！请保持冷静，并在我们的频道上关注我们的最新动态。”

paras.en: The Ukrainian Central Intelligence Agency said there had been a failure in the app, and urged people to use other sources of information to clarify the situation on the threat of air strikes.
paras.zh: 乌克兰中央情报局表示，该应用程序出现故障，并敦促人们使用其他信息来源来澄清有关空袭威胁的情况。

paras.en: A few hours later Russian authorities said its app was hacked. A Ukrainian espionage group claimed fake warnings of nuclear strikes inside Russia had been sent to users.
paras.zh: 几个小时后，俄罗斯当局表示其应用程序遭到黑客攻击。一个乌克兰间谍组织声称，俄罗斯境内核打击的虚假警告已发送给用户。

paras.en: Russia has the world's biggest nuclear arsenal, and President Vladimir Putin has repeatedly suggested an openness to using all weapons at Russia's disposal.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯拥有世界上最大的核武库，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京（ Vladimir Putin ）一再建议对使用俄罗斯拥有的所有武器持开放态度。

paras.en: The alerts, in Ukrainian, started at approximately 22:47 (20:47 GMT), with red-level air raids apparently issued nationwide. Additional warnings were issued in Kyiv, with the first reading: "Radiation threat. Radiation threat declared in Kyiv."
paras.zh: 乌克兰语的警报大约在22:47 （格林尼治标准时间20:47 ）开始，显然在全国范围内发布了红色空袭。基辅还发布了其他警告，一读如下： “辐射威胁。在基辅宣布的辐射威胁。”

paras.en: The next message, written in Russian, came at 22:48, which read: "Hi! There will be a nuclear alert across Ukraine. Don't worry, it's Oreshnik flying".
paras.zh: 下一条消息是用俄语写的，在22:48到达，上面写着： “嗨！乌克兰各地将出现核警报。别担心，这是奥列什尼克飞行。”

paras.en: A third alert, at 22:49, again in Ukrainian, said "Chemical threat. There is a threat of a chemical attack on Kyiv. Don't go outside."
paras.zh: 第三次警报于22:49再次以乌克兰语说： “化学威胁。基辅受到化学武器袭击的威胁。不要到外面去。”

paras.en: At 22:49, a fourth alert stated there was a "Street fighting threat. Street fighting is taking place in Kyiv. Don't go outside."
paras.zh: 22点49分，第四个警报声称有“街头格斗的威胁。基辅正在发生巷战。不要到外面去。”

paras.en: At 23:53 a series of all clear messages were then delivered to users' phones, which were connected to each of the previous Kyiv alerts, individually declaring each threat clear.
paras.zh: 在23:53 ，一系列清晰的消息被传递到用户的手机上，这些手机连接到之前的每个基辅警报，分别宣布每个威胁清除。

paras.en: In a separate post on Telegram, the Ukrainian Central Intelligence Agency said that due to the Air Alert application, the Radiation Hazard signal was played on loudspeaker devices in the Lviv region, and added there was no threat of radiation hazard.
paras.zh: 在Telegram的另一个帖子中，乌克兰中央情报局表示，由于空中警报应用程序，辐射危害信号在利沃夫地区的扬声器设备上播放，并补充说没有辐射危害的威胁。

paras.en: If the alert app is not working, Ukraine's Centre for Countering Disinformation advises the public to turn on notifications on their smartphones, pay attention to sirens, and to only read official sources
paras.zh: 如果警报应用程序无法正常工作，乌克兰反虚假信息中心建议公众在智能手机上打开通知，注意警报器，并仅阅读官方消息来源

paras.en: Several leaders of other regions also posted on Telegram that the app had apparently been hacked and there was no local threat.
paras.zh: 其他地区的几位领导人也在Telegram上发帖称，该应用程序显然已被黑客入侵，没有本地威胁。

paras.en: "Everything is calm in the region for now," said Svitlana Onyshchuk, the governor of the Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast. The app had reported a red-level air raid alert for the oblast in Ukraine's east, between 22:50 and 23:57.
paras.zh: 伊万诺-弗兰科夫斯克州州长Svitlana Onyshchuk说： “目前该地区一切都很平静。”该应用程序报告了乌克兰东部州在22:50至23:57之间的红色空袭警报。

paras.en: The Vinnytsia regional head, Natalya Zabolotna, said there had been a cyber-attack on the Air Alert app and posted a warning on Telegram not to click on the link in the message, which could be a phishing attempt.
paras.zh: Vinnytsia地区负责人Natalya Zabolotna表示， Air Alert应用程序遭到网络攻击，并在Telegram上发布警告，不要点击消息中的链接，这可能是网络钓鱼企图。

paras.en: The Air Alert app is supported by the Ministry of Digital Transformation of Ukraine, and informs users instantly about the beginning and end of defence alerts. The ministry had earlier said the app was temporarily disabled for maintenance after it had "apparently been compromised". It urged residents to turn on their smartphones' emergency notifications so they could receive state-issued distress signals.
paras.zh: Air Alert应用程序由乌克兰数字化转型部提供支持，可即时通知用户防御警报的开始和结束。该部早些时候曾表示，该应用程序在“显然已被泄露”后暂时停用进行维护。它敦促居民打开智能手机的紧急通知，以便他们可以接收国家发出的遇险信号。

paras.en: A few hours after the false alerts in Ukraine, Russia's ministry of emergency situations said its app had been subjected to "a massive cyberattack" which sent "fake information to the public".
paras.zh: 在乌克兰发生虚假警报几个小时后，俄罗斯紧急情况部表示，其应用程序遭到了“大规模网络攻击” ，向公众发送了“虚假信息”。

paras.en: No further details were given by the ministry or state media.
paras.zh: 该部或国家媒体没有提供进一步的细节。

paras.en: Ukrainian news outlet, UNN, reported the hack sent fake alerts of a nuclear threat inside Russia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰新闻媒体UNN报道称，黑客在俄罗斯境内发出了核威胁的虚假警报。

paras.en: Atesh, a partisan Ukrainian group operating inside Russian held territory, said on its Telegram page that the app had been hacked, accompanied with laughing emojis.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯控制区内活动的乌克兰党派组织Atesh在其Telegram页面上表示，该应用程序已被黑客入侵，并伴随着大笑的表情符号。

paras.en: A screenshot of a purported emergency alert published by Atesh, which has not been verified by the BBC, told users to "urgently" stock up on provisions for three weeks and take cover in basements. It also used obscene language. Atesh has been contacted for comment.
paras.zh: Atesh发布的所谓紧急警报的屏幕截图尚未得到英国广播公司的验证，它告诉用户“紧急”储备三周的粮食，并在地下室掩护。它还使用了淫秽的语言。已联系Atesh征求意见。

paras.en: The alerts occurred just minutes before the end of a localised ceasefire in Ukraine's front-line Kherson region, which was implemented last Tuesday and officially ended at 23:00 Sunday.
paras.zh: 警报发生在乌克兰前线赫尔松地区局部停火结束前几分钟，该停火于上周二实施，并于周日23:00正式结束。

paras.en: Fighting had continued elsewhere while the Kherson ceasefire was in place, to allow civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky.
paras.zh: 在赫尔松停火到位期间，其他地方的战斗仍在继续，以便让平民撤离俄罗斯占领的奥列什基市。

paras.en: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯于2022年2月发动了对乌克兰的全面入侵。

articles.title: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat erupts

paras.en: A Democrat in Michigan has endorsed the Republican candidate in the state's crucial US Senate contest, as a spat with her own party's candidate Abdul El-Sayed escalated just days before the vote.
paras.zh: 密歇根州的一名民主党人在该州至关重要的美国参议院竞选中支持这位共和党候选人，因为与她自己党的候选人阿卜杜勒·埃尔·赛义德（ Abdul El-Sayed ）的口角在投票前几天升级。

paras.en: Haley Stevens, a sitting congresswoman who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to El-Sayed, made a surprise appearance alongside the Republican candidate Mike Rogers on Sunday.
paras.zh: 现任国会女议员海莉·史蒂文斯（ Haley Stevens ）在民主党参议院提名中输给了萨耶德（ El-Sayed ） ，周日与共和党候选人迈克·罗杰斯（ Mike Rogers ）一起出人意料地露面

paras.en: "I don't belong in Abdul's campaign," she said in a video posted to X shortly after that appearance. "Who we are as Michiganders is not hate and is not what we are getting out from our Democratic nominee right now."
paras.zh: “我不属于阿卜杜勒的竞选活动，”她在露面后不久发布给X的视频中说。“我们作为密歇根人的身份并不是仇恨，也不是我们现在从民主党候选人那里得到的。”

paras.en: "That's why I am endorsing Mike Rogers," Stevens said.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我支持迈克·罗杰斯，”史蒂文斯说。

paras.en: The move stunned many of Stevens' fellow Democrats who condemned her decision to break from the party and switch her support just two days before the election, with one calling it a "despicable betrayal".
paras.zh: 此举震惊了史蒂文斯的许多民主党同僚，他们谴责她在大选前两天决定退出该党并改变她的支持，其中一人称这是“卑鄙的背叛”。

paras.en: The public feud between Stevens, a centrist Democrat, and El-Sayed, who represents the party's left-wing, has boiled over in recent days.
paras.zh: 最近几天，中间派民主党人史蒂文斯和代表该党左翼的萨伊德之间的公开争执已经沸腾。

paras.en: Stevens called on El-Sayed to denounce a campaign advert from an outside liberal group that linked US support for Israel with high prices. El-Sayed criticised the advert and said he had nothing to do with its contents.
paras.zh: 史蒂文斯呼吁El-Sayed谴责一个外部自由派团体的竞选广告，该广告将美国对以色列的支持与高价格联系起来。El-Sayed批评了该广告，并表示他与其内容无关。

paras.en: Stevens had been scheduled to appear at an event with El-Sayed on Sunday in an effort to display party unity, but he reportedly asked her not to come and she chose to attend a church service with his Republican opponent instead.
paras.zh: 史蒂文斯原定于周日与El-Sayed一起出现在活动中，以展示党的团结，但据报道，他要求她不要来，她选择与他的共和党对手一起参加教堂服务。

paras.en: "This is a very close election, we all know that, but Abdul made clear that I was not welcome in his campaign, that he didn't need me there, that he didn't want me there," Stevens told reporters as she stood alongside Rogers outside the church.
paras.zh: “这是一次非常接近的选举，我们都知道，但阿卜杜勒明确表示，我在他的竞选活动中不受欢迎，他不需要我在那里，他不希望我在那里，”史蒂文斯在教堂外与罗杰斯站在一起时告诉记者。

paras.en: When asked about Stevens' endorsement, El-Sayed told reporters he was focused on the problems Michiganders are facing.
paras.zh: 当被问及史蒂文斯的支持时， El-Sayed告诉记者，他专注于密歇根州人面临的问题。

paras.en: "At the end of the day, I don't think about Haley Stevens," he said on Sunday. "None of this matters."
paras.zh: “归根结底，我不会想到海莉·史蒂文斯，”他在周日说。“这些都不重要。”

paras.en: The Michigan Senate race is considered by analysts to be one of the tightest in Tuesday's midterm elections. It is one of a handful of battleground contests that will ultimately decide control of the Senate.
paras.zh: 分析师认为，密歇根州参议院的竞选是周二中期选举中最激烈的竞选之一。这是少数几个最终决定参议院控制权的战场竞赛之一。

paras.en: The seat is currently held by a retiring Democrat and the last time a Republican was elected to this Senate seat was in 1994. But in presidential elections, it is one of the crucial swing states - Michigan voted for Joe Biden in 2020 but Donald Trump in 2024.
paras.zh: 该席位目前由一位即将退休的民主党人担任，上一次共和党人当选该参议院席位是在1994年。但在总统选举中，它是关键的摇摆州之一-密歇根州在2020年投票支持乔·拜登，但在2024年投票支持唐纳德·特朗普。

paras.en: Rogers welcomed Stevens' endorsement and said it showed "courage" during brief remarks with reporters.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯对史蒂文斯的支持表示欢迎，并表示在与记者的简短谈话中表现出“勇气”。

paras.en: President Donald Trump echoed that sentiment during a campaign rally in Iowa, calling her "very brave".
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在爱荷华州的一次竞选集会上回应了这种情绪，称她“非常勇敢”。

paras.en: "I don't know Haley. I've never met Haley. But Haley said what few people were willing to say," Trump said. "I'd love her to join the Republican Party actually."
paras.zh: “我不认识海莉。我从未见过海莉。但海莉说了很少有人愿意说的话，”特朗普说。“我真的很希望她能加入共和党。”

paras.en: Many of Stevens' staff reportedly resigned immediately after her announcement, while the chair of the Democratic Party in Michigan said her decision "shows that she has abandoned everything she claims to care about".
paras.zh: 据报道，史蒂文斯的许多员工在宣布辞职后立即辞职，而密歇根州民主党主席表示，她的决定“表明她已经放弃了她声称关心的一切”。

paras.en: "We reject the attempts by Stevens and bad-faith actors to divide our party and undermine our momentum," Curtis Hertel said in a statement.
paras.zh: 柯蒂斯·赫特尔（ Curtis Hertel ）在一份声明中说： “我们拒绝史蒂文斯和恶意演员分裂我们党并破坏我们势头的企图。”

paras.en: Top Senate Democrat Chuck Schumer called Stevens' endorsement of Rogers "a despicable betrayal".
paras.zh: 参议院高级民主党人查克·舒默（ Chuck Schumer ）称史蒂文斯对罗杰斯的支持是“卑鄙的背叛”。

paras.en: In downtown Detroit, several Democrats the BBC spoke to said they were disappointed by Stevens' endorsement of Rogers.
paras.zh: 在底特律市中心， BBC采访的几位民主党人表示，他们对史蒂文斯对罗杰斯的支持感到失望。

paras.en: "I just genuinely don't understand it," said Summer Lawrence, a 21-year-old student. "I do think it's a betrayal of the party because the things she stands for are not the same things that he stands for as a Republican."
paras.zh: “我真的不明白，” 21岁的学生Summer Lawrence说。“我确实认为这是对党的背叛，因为她所代表的东西与他作为共和党人所代表的东西不同。”

paras.en: "Maybe she had frustrations with the party," Matthew Barera, another Michigan voter, said.
paras.zh: 另一位密歇根州选民马修·巴雷拉（ Matthew Barera ）说： “也许她对党感到沮丧。”

paras.en: Others, including Republicans who support Rogers, said they doubted it would make a difference to the race.
paras.zh: 其他人，包括支持罗杰斯的共和党人，表示他们怀疑这会对比赛产生影响。

paras.en: "People can see right through her actions, you know? She's just angry," Marissa Lee, a Rogers supporter, told the BBC. "She is not going to make anybody change their mind."
paras.zh: “人们可以直接看到她的行为，你知道吗？她只是生气，”罗杰斯的支持者玛丽莎·李告诉英国广播公司。“她不会让任何人改变主意的。”

paras.en: Over the weekend, as Stevens' criticism of El-Sayed escalated, a number of Democratic politicians in Michigan publicly encouraged her to end the feud and back the party's candidates more directly.
paras.zh: 上周末，随着史蒂文斯对El-Sayed的批评升级，密歇根州的一些民主党政客公开鼓励她结束不和，更直接地支持该党的候选人。

paras.en: The primary, and the conflict between the pair, has underlined divisions over the party's direction ahead of the 2028 presidential election.
paras.zh: 初选以及两人之间的冲突凸显了2028年总统大选前该党在方向上的分歧。

paras.en: Former public health official El-Sayed, who is the son of Egyptian immigrants, has channelled grassroots frustration with Washington politics as well as US ties to Israel.
paras.zh: 前公共卫生官员El-Sayed是埃及移民的儿子，他引发了基层对华盛顿政治以及美国与以色列关系的挫败感。

paras.en: Stevens is a more centrist Democrat - and had the support of party figures such as Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer during the primary race.
paras.zh: 史蒂文斯是更中立的民主党人，在初选期间得到了密歇根州州长格雷琴·惠特默（ Gretchen Whitmer ）等政党人物的支持。

paras.en: The party is hoping to regain control of the Senate in Tuesday's elections, but will need a net gain of four seats to do so. A loss in Michigan - which they currently hold - would represent a major blow and leave them needing to flip five seats.
paras.zh: 该党希望在周二的选举中重新控制参议院，但需要净增加四个席位。密歇根州的损失-他们目前持有-将构成重大打击，使他们需要翻转五个席位。

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料如何为现代机械提供动力

paras.en: Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?
paras.zh: 您是否想过，从轰鸣的工程机械到耕地的农业机械，再到穿梭于工厂的工业设备，是什么让它们能够实现精确的启动、平稳的运行和可靠的制动？

paras.en: The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.
paras.zh: 答案就在于一个看似微不足道却至关重要的核心部件：摩擦材料。它充当机械的“安全卫士”和“动力纽带”，保证每一次制动都安全有效，每一次动力传递平稳无瑕。

paras.en: Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
paras.zh: 在众多的摩擦材料家族中，湿式摩擦材料因其卓越的可靠性、安全性和超长的使用寿命而成为现代机械的新宠。在湿式材料中，纸基摩擦材料以其优异的综合性能、成本效益和广阔的应用前景脱颖而出，成为主导力量。

paras.en: Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
paras.zh: 今天，让我们深入探究这个“无名英雄”——纸基摩擦材料的迷人世界。

paras.en: What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
paras.zh: 什么是纸基摩擦材料？ — 海绵状动力核心

paras.en: Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.
paras.zh: 想象一下有无数微小孔隙的“海绵”——这就是纸基摩擦材料最直观的形象。

paras.en: It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
paras.zh: 它是一种具有网状多孔结构的材料，由增强纤维、功能填料和粘结剂树脂三种核心成分组成。这种独特的结构赋予了它非凡的功能：

paras.en: - Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.
paras.zh: - 储油能力：多孔结构就像一个微型“油库”，能够储存大量润滑剂。

paras.en: - Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
paras.zh: - 动态润滑：当摩擦片和配合片接合并受到压力时，材料内的润滑剂立即被挤压到摩擦表面上，形成坚韧的润滑膜，从而实现平滑、温和的“湿”摩擦。

paras.en: - Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.
paras.zh: - 自我恢复：当摩擦片分离时，材料会像记忆海绵一样反弹，将润滑剂“吸收”回毛孔中，为下一次操作做好准备。

paras.en: It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
paras.zh: 正是这种“储油-挤油-回油”的动态循环，让纸基摩擦材料在油浴环境下表现良好，实现了高耐用性和稳定摩擦性能的完美结合。

paras.en: Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?
paras.zh: 探索核心绩效：三个关键因素如何影响它？

paras.en: The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料的性能并不是静态的。就像顶尖运动员一样，其成绩受到“场地”、“装备”、“条件”的影响。让我们来看看这三个关键因素如何影响其性能。

paras.en: Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants
paras.zh: 因素一：润滑油的“阶段效应”

paras.en: Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
paras.zh: 纸基摩擦材料对润滑剂高度敏感，不同的润滑剂为其性能创造了不同的“阶段”。即使是相同的摩擦材料，当接触不同的润滑剂时也会表现出明显不同的摩擦特性（尤其是动摩擦系数）。

paras.en: Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
paras.zh: 图 1：纸基摩擦材料在齿轮油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil
paras.zh: 图2：同材质在液压油中的动摩擦系数曲线

paras.en: Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
paras.zh: 解读：上图清楚地表明，相同的材料在齿轮油和液压油中的表现截然不同。此外，润滑油中添加的各种添加剂（如分散剂和抗磨剂）会与材料表面发生复杂的相互作用，进一步影响其摩擦性能。因此，为纸基摩擦材料选择合适的油是实现最佳性能的第一步。

paras.en: Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.
paras.zh: 密度是纸基摩擦材料的王牌。它与材料的孔隙率直接相关，从而导致性能方面的微妙平衡。

paras.en: High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.
paras.zh: 高密度（低孔隙率）意味着材料更致密，从而具有更好的强度和导热性、更低的磨损率和更长的使用寿命。然而，其缺点是储油能力降低，这可能导致摩擦系数降低并损害动力传输。

paras.en: Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
paras.zh: 低密度（高孔隙率）意味着材料孔隙较多，从而产生更大的储油能力和更高的摩擦系数，从而可以提供更大的制动力或传递扭矩。但其缺点是机械强度和耐磨性降低，使用寿命缩短。

paras.en: Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
paras.zh: 图 3：不同密度材料的动摩擦系数比较（类型 2 至类型 6，密度增加）

paras.en: Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities
paras.zh: 图4：不同密度材料的磨损率比较

paras.en: Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
paras.zh: 解读：图3和图4生动地说明了这种平衡行为。没有绝对的好或坏，只有合适。选择纸基摩擦材料时，必须根据具体应用要求（例如高扭矩与长寿命）确定摩擦系数和耐用性之间的最佳权衡。

paras.en: Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions
paras.zh: 因素三：运行条件的极端挑战

paras.en: In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.
paras.zh: 除了油的类型和密度之外，实际操作条件，例如表面压力、滑动速度和油温，对纸基摩擦材料提出了极大的挑战。这些因素直接影响摩擦界面的温度、油膜的厚度和稳定性，从而动态地改变摩擦系数。

paras.en: Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
paras.zh: 因此，请记住：特定纸基摩擦材料的摩擦系数不是一个固定值，而是在特定操作条件下通过广泛和反复测试确定的性能范围。

paras.en: Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery
paras.zh: 广泛应用：为机械注入强大的“心脏”

paras.en: Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
paras.zh: 凭借其优异的综合性能和可定制性，卡莱制动摩擦材料纸基摩擦材料已成功应用于各类重型机械的核心部件，成为其强大而可靠的“心脏”。

paras.en: We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
paras.zh: 我们了解不同的机器和应用需要截然不同的摩擦材料。例如：

paras.en: - Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
paras.zh: - 工程机械（如挖掘机和装载机）的行车制动器需要能够在高负载下提供稳定、强大制动力的材料，以确保安全。

paras.en: - Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
paras.zh: - 农业机械（如拖拉机）的动力换档变速箱需要能够提供平稳接合和出色耐热性的材料，以应对频繁换档。

paras.en: - Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.
paras.zh: - 工业机械离合器需要响应快且使用寿命长的材料，以确保生产线连续高效运行。

paras.en: To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
paras.zh: 为此，卡莱制动摩擦开发了一系列针对不同应用场景的特种纸基摩擦材料，为每位客户提供最合适、最可靠的解决方案。

paras.en: Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
paras.zh: 持续创新，驱动未来

paras.en: Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.
paras.zh: 技术进步永无止境。为了满足日益苛刻的应用要求并拓宽市场前景，Carlisle Brake & Friction 始终走在创新的前沿。

paras.en: We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.
paras.zh: 我们不仅不断优化纸基摩擦材料的配方和加工工艺以突破其性能极限，而且还积极探索具有更高性能的下一代湿式摩擦材料。这些研发工作取得了重大进展，旨在为全球客户提供更多样化、更先进的选择，驱动未来机械的无限可能。

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees
paras.zh: 与麦地那市长和员工一起庆祝 100 周年

paras.en: MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳 — 2025 年 9 月 24 日 — 高性能制动和摩擦解决方案开发和制造领域的全球领导者 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF) 今天欢迎梅迪纳市长 Dennis Hanwell、经济发展总监 Kimberly Marshall 和梅迪纳商会执行董事 Jaclyn Ringstmeier 在位于湖路 920 号的公司总部进行了特别合影。该活动是为了纪念 CarlisleCBF 成立 100 周年及其在麦地那社区的持久存在。

paras.en: The photo op featured Mayor Hanwell alongside Carlisle’s Operations Leader, David Smith, and a number of employees who have been with the company for decades. The occasion honored CarlisleCBF’s century of innovation and its deep roots in the Medina area, where it has been a significant employer and community partner.
paras.zh: 这张照片的主角是汉威尔市长、卡莱尔的运营负责人大卫·史密斯以及一些在公司工作了几十年的员工。此次活动旨在表彰 CarlisleCBF 的百年创新历程及其在麦地那地区的深厚根基，该公司一直是该地区重要的雇主和社区合作伙伴。

paras.en: "We are incredibly proud of our history and our strong connection to the city of Medina," said David Smith. "This milestone is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our employees, many of whom have been with us for decades. We are grateful for the continued support of Mayor Hanwell and the entire Medina community."
paras.zh: 大卫史密斯说：“我们对我们的历史以及我们与麦地那市的紧密联系感到无比自豪。” “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的辛勤工作和奉献精神，其中许多人已经在我们身边工作了数十年。我们感谢汉威尔市长和整个麦地那社区的持续支持。”

paras.en: The photo op followed a recent employee and family event at the Medina plant that celebrated the 100-year milestone. The celebration was filled with games, face painting, food, and fun for all ages, reinforcing the company's commitment to its employees and their families.
paras.zh: 这张照片是在麦地那工厂最近举行的庆祝 100 周年里程碑的员工和家庭活动之后​​拍摄的。庆祝活动充满了适合各个年龄段的游戏、面部彩绘、美食和乐趣，强化了公司对员工及其家人的承诺。

paras.en: Mayor Hanwell expressed his gratitude for CarlisleCBF’s presence in the city. “Carlisle has been a part of the Medina community for nearly 65 years, providing good jobs and a strong economic foundation,” said Mayor Hanwell. "We are proud to celebrate their 100-year anniversary and recognize the significant role they have played in our city’s growth and prosperity."
paras.zh: 汉威尔市长对 CarlisleCBF 来到该市表示感谢。 “近 65 年来，卡莱尔一直是麦地那社区的一部分，提供了良好的就业机会和强大的经济基础，”汉威尔市长说。 “我们很自豪能够庆祝他们的 100 周年纪念日，并认识到他们在我们城市的发展和繁荣中发挥的重要作用。”

paras.en: CarlisleCBF, a brand of CentroMotion, was founded in 1925 and has grown to become a global leader in its field, serving a wide range of markets including agriculture, construction, and mining.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，成立于 1925 年，现已发展成为该领域的全球领导者，服务于农业、建筑和采矿等广泛市场。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a leading global provider of highly engineered and integrated brake and friction solutions for a wide range of industrial applications. With over 100 years of experience, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance products to its customers worldwide.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，是一家为各种工业应用提供精心设计的集成制动和摩擦解决方案的全球领先供应商。该公司拥有 100 多年的经验，致力于为全球客户提供创新、可靠和高性能的产品。

articles.title: CentroMotion @Agritechnica 2025

paras.en: Agritechnica 2025 was an incredible opportunity to connect with industry leaders, customers, and partners from around the world. We want to extend a sincere thank you to everyone who visited the CarlisleCBF and CentroMotion team at the show.
paras.zh: Agritechnica 2025 是一个与来自世界各地的行业领导者、客户和合作伙伴建立联系的绝佳机会。我们要向在展会上参观 CarlisleCBF 和 CentroMotion 团队的所有人致以诚挚的谢意。

paras.en: We’re excited to share the CentroMotion Agritechnica 2025 video, which captures the energy of our stand and highlights the innovative agricultural equipment products we showcased. From advanced friction technologies to solutions designed for the future of farming, this video gives you a front-row look at what makes Carlisle Brake & Friction a trusted partner in the Ag market.
paras.zh: 我们很高兴分享 CentroMotion Agritechnica 2025 视频，该视频捕捉了我们展台的活力并突出了我们展示的创新农业设备产品。从先进的摩擦技术到为未来农业设计的解决方案，该视频让您直观地了解是什么让 Carlisle Brake & Friction 成为农业市场值得信赖的合作伙伴。

paras.en: 👉 Watch the video here: [Agritechnica 2025 Video]
paras.zh: 👉在这里观看视频：[Agritechnica 2025 视频]

paras.en: Thank you again for making Agritechnica 2025 a success. We look forward to continuing the conversation and driving innovation together!
paras.zh: 再次感谢您使 Agritechnica 2025 取得成功。我们期待继续对话并共同推动创新！

articles.title: NABC to hold new fundraiser during SEMA Week
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The National Auto Body Council (NABC) and the Changing and Saving Lives Foundation are hosting a new fall fundraiser this year, Nov. 1-6, during SEMA Week in Las Vegas and through nationwide virtual participation.
paras.zh: 美国国家汽车车身委员会 (NABC) 和改变与拯救生命基金会将于今年 11 月 1 日至 6 日在拉斯维加斯 SEMA 周期间通过全国虚拟参与方式举办一场新的秋季筹款活动。

paras.en: The “Steps to Change and Save Lives Challenge,” presented by Enterprise, will trade the usual golf spikes for walking shoes to benefit the NABC Recycled Rides and NABC First Responder Emergency Extrication (F.R.E.E.) programs.
paras.zh: Enterprise 提出的“改变和拯救生命的步骤挑战”将用普通的高尔夫球鞋换成步行鞋，以使 NABC 回收游乐设施和 NABC 急救人员紧急救援 (F.R.E.E.) 计划受益。

paras.en: Every year, the program gifts around 250 vehicles to veterans, military members, and families in need to get them to work, school, and medical appointments, and take care of their families. The program has gifted more than 3,850 vehicles to date, valued at nearly $69 million.
paras.zh: 该计划每年都会向退伍军人、军人和有需要的家庭赠送约 250 辆汽车，供他们上班、上学、就医和照顾家人。迄今为止，该计划已捐赠了超过 3,850 辆汽车，价值近 6,900 万美元。

paras.en: The F.R.E.E. program provides free training to more than 1,500 first responders each year on how to rescue those involved in collisions from late-model vehicles. More than 7,000 first responders have been trained through the program.
paras.zh: F.R.E.E.该计划每年为 1,500 多名急救人员提供免费培训，教他们如何营救新型车辆碰撞事故中的人员。超过 7,000 名急救人员已通过该计划接受了培训。

paras.en: Through the upcoming fundraiser, individuals can compete for top honors, and company teams can challenge competitors.
paras.zh: 通过即将举行的筹款活动，个人可以争夺最高荣誉，公司团队可以挑战竞争对手。

paras.en: To participate, select the pledge amount per step and complete registration to receive a personalized link. Next, download the app or save the link to your personal step-tracker page. Track your steps and log them each day. Participants can check their progress daily on the leaderboard.
paras.zh: 要参与，请选择每步的承诺金额并完成注册以接收个性化链接。接下来，下载应用程序或将链接保存到您的个人步数跟踪器页面。跟踪您的步数并每天记录下来。参与者可以每天在排行榜上查看自己的进度。

paras.en: At the end of the week, tally your final steps and complete your donation. All donations are tax-deductible. The winners will be announced at that time. Top performers will win prizes. Sponsorship opportunities are also available.
paras.zh: 在周末，统计您的最后步骤并完成您的捐赠。所有捐款均可免税。获奖者名单将于届时公布。表现最好的人将赢得奖品。还提供赞助机会。

paras.en: “The collision repair industry has always generously supported our efforts to give back to those in need, and we wanted to provide a new, unique way for them to be involved in helping veterans, military members, families, and first responders,” said Tom Wolf, NABC Board of Directors chairman, in a press release. “Everyone attending the Las Vegas event is already logging their steps and sharing their daily data with their colleagues, so this is a creative way to capture their enthusiasm and efforts for a good cause.”
paras.zh: NABC 董事会主席汤姆·沃尔夫 (Tom Wolf) 在一份新闻稿中表示：“碰撞修复行业一直慷慨支持我们回馈有需要的人的努力，我们希望为他们提供一种新的、独特的方式来参与帮助退伍军人、军人、家庭和急救人员。” “参加拉斯维加斯活动的每个人都已经记录了他们的步数并与同事分享了他们的日常数据，因此这是一种创造性的方式来捕捉他们的热情和为美好事业所做的努力。”

articles.title: California insurance commissioner race receives record PAC donations
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Political Action Committees (PACs) have contributed a record $6 million in campaign donations to the California Insurance Commission race, according to a CalMatters report.
paras.zh: 根据 CalMatters 的一份报告，政治行动委员会 (PAC) 为加州保险委员会竞选提供了创纪录的 600 万美元竞选捐款。

paras.en: The article says this includes $3.2 million to support state Sen. Ben Allen, a Democrat, and $1.5 million to oppose his opponent, Jane Kim, also a Democrat.
paras.zh: 文章称，其中包括 320 万美元用于支持民主党州参议员本·艾伦 (Ben Allen)，以及 150 万美元用于反对他的对手、也是民主党人简·金 (Jane Kim)。

paras.en: While both candidates have said they wouldn’t take donations from insurance companies, CalMatters reports that some of the PAC funding comes from insurance groups.
paras.zh: 虽然两位候选人都表示不会接受保险公司的捐款，但 CalMatters 报道称 PAC 的部分资金来自保险集团。

paras.en: Bail bonds insurers donated $30,000 to PACs supporting Allen, the article states. It adds that a company connected to the bail bonds industry donated another $9,500, and a health insurance PAC donated $48,000.
paras.zh: 文章称，保释债券保险公司向支持艾伦的 PAC 捐赠了 3 万美元。它还补充说，一家与保释债券行业有关的公司又捐赠了 9,500 美元，一家健康保险 PAC 捐赠了 48,000 美元。

paras.en: “I didn’t ask for this and don’t welcome it,” Allen told CalMatters.
paras.zh: “我没有要求这个，也不欢迎它，”艾伦告诉 CalMatters。

paras.en: CalMatters explains that super PACs can spend unlimited money as long as they don’t coordinate with the candidate’s campaign. Candidates also cannot return the money.
paras.zh: CalMatters 解释说，只要超级政治行动委员会不与候选人的竞选活动协调，他们就可以无限花钱。候选人也无法退还这笔钱。

paras.en: Allen did return some insurance industry donations made early in the campaign, the article states.
paras.zh: 文章称，艾伦确实退还了竞选初期保险业的一些捐款。

paras.en: “The contributions that come in are a reflection of what the (insurance) industry believes is the best outcome for them,” CalMatters reports Kim as saying. “These contributions are an investment in him and themselves, not for consumers.”
paras.zh: 据 CalMatters 报道，Kim 表示：“收到的捐款反映了（保险）行业认为对他们来说最好的结果。” “这些贡献是对他和他们自己的投资，而不是对消费者的投资。”

paras.en: Kim also argues that she hasn’t accepted corporate PAC donations.
paras.zh: Kim 还辩称，她没有接受企业 PAC 的捐款。

paras.en: Allen has served in the state’s legislature since 2014, according to his campaign website. He lists climate and environmental policies as a focus during his tenure.
paras.zh: 据艾伦的竞选网站称，他自 2014 年以来一直在该州立法机构任职。他将气候和环境政策列为任期内的重点。

paras.en: Allen’s plan focuses on strengthening the state’s insurance market as wildfires and climate disasters intensify.
paras.zh: 艾伦的计划重点是随着野火和气候灾害加剧，加强该州的保险市场。

paras.en: “My plan will restore a competitive insurance market, ensure Californians are treated fairly after disasters, and build resilient communities that can withstand the climate challenges ahead,” he states on his website.
paras.zh: 他在网站上表示：“我的计划将恢复有竞争力的保险市场，确保加州人在灾难后得到公平对待，并建立能够抵御未来气候挑战的有弹性的社区。”

paras.en: Fighting insurers that “deny and delay” and post-disaster insurer compliance are other planned action items, Allen’s site claims.
paras.zh: 艾伦的网站称，打击“拒绝和拖延”的保险公司以及灾后保险公司的合规是其他计划采取的行动项目。

paras.en: This would include higher upfront payments for coverage requiring insurers to clearly explain claim denials and maintain post-disaster real-time reporting on delays and outstanding claims.
paras.zh: 这将包括更高的保险预付款，要求保险公司明确解释索赔被拒绝的情况，并维护有关延误和未决索赔的灾后实时报告。

paras.en: Allen also outlines how he’d make the department more transparent and accountable. The website states Allen would modernize customer service and filings infrastructure, improve consumer communication, and provide data transparency.
paras.zh: 艾伦还概述了他将如何使该部门更加透明和负责任。该网站表示，艾伦将实现客户服务和备案基础设施现代化，改善消费者沟通，并提供数据透明度。

paras.en: Kim previously served on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, as California political director for Bernie Sanders, and as California director for the Working Families Party, according to her campaign website.
paras.zh: 据她的竞选网站称，金此前曾在旧金山监事会任职，担任伯尼·桑德斯的加州政治主任，以及工作家庭党的加州主任。

paras.en: Her priorities focus on “affordable, available insurance for all,” the website states. She proposes a single-payer disaster insurance policy for state residents.
paras.zh: 该网站称，她的首要任务是“为所有人提供负担得起的、可用的保险”。她提议为州居民提供单一付款人灾难保险政策。

paras.en: The website also says she’ll ensure premiums cover claims, or lower them.
paras.zh: 该网站还表示，她将确保保费覆盖索赔，或降低保费。

paras.en: “Insurance companies should spend premium dollars on their intended purpose: protecting policyholders,” the website states. “If companies collect more than they need to cover claims and a reasonable profit, that money should go back to policyholders or be invested in statewide resilience, not huge payouts at our expense — like the $27 million salary one insurance company CEO was paid last year.”
paras.zh: 该网站指出：“保险公司应该将保费用于其预期目的：保护保单持有人。” “如果公司收取的金额超出了他们支付索赔和合理利润所需的金额，那么这笔钱应该返还给保单持有人或投资于全州的恢复力，而不是由我们承担巨额支出——就像去年向一位保险公司首席执行官支付的 2700 万美元的薪水一样。”

paras.en: Her site states that a long-term goal is to build a public auto insurance option to compete in the market.
paras.zh: 她的网站指出，长期目标是建立公共汽车保险选项以参与市场竞争。

paras.en: She also notes that she’s focused on “fast and fair claims.” This includes freezing rates when a claim is filed, penalizing delays to speed up payments, and immediate payouts.
paras.zh: 她还指出，她专注于“快速、公平的索赔”。这包括提出索赔时冻结费率、惩罚延迟以加快付款以及立即付款。

paras.en: Under Kim, insurance companies would be held accountable through market conduct examinations and elevated complaint rates, according to the website. She also proposes an insurance performance dashboard that consumers can use to assess insurer risks before choosing a policy.
paras.zh: 据该网站称，在金的领导下，保险公司将通过市场行为检查和提高投诉率来追究责任。她还提出了一个保险绩效仪表板，消费者可以在选择保单之前使用它来评估保险公司的风险。

articles.title: Tuesday during SEMA Week: CIC and the annual Red Carpet Awards
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Tuesday during SEMA Week in Las Vegas will be packed with industry news and celebration as the Collision Industry Conference (CIC) fall meeting takes place, followed by a CIC reception and the annual Collision Industry Red Carpet Awards.
paras.zh: 周二，拉斯维加斯 SEMA 周期间将举行碰撞行业大会 (CIC) 秋季会议，届时将充满行业新闻和庆祝活动，随后将举行 CIC 招待会和年度碰撞行业红毯奖。

paras.en: Both will be held at the Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino. Red Carpet Awards will bring together collision repair professionals from across the industry to celebrate the individuals and organizations whose leadership, service, and contributions continue to move the industry forward, according to a Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) press release.
paras.zh: 这两场比赛都将在拉斯维加斯西门赌场度假村举行。根据碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) 的新闻稿，红地毯奖将汇集整个行业的碰撞修复专业人士，以表彰那些在领导、服务和贡献方面继续推动行业向前发展的个人和组织。

paras.en: The CIC meeting will be from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., followed by its reception at 6 p.m. The awards program will begin at 7:30 p.m. The Red Carpet Awards ceremony is free to attend with first-come, first-served seating; cocktail attire is encouraged.
paras.zh: CIC会议将于上午8点至下午5点举行，随后于下午6点举行招待会。颁奖典礼将于晚上 7:30 开始。红地毯颁奖典礼可免费参加，座位先到先得；鼓励穿着鸡尾酒会服装。

paras.en: From industry veterans to rising stars, the evening will spotlight outstanding accomplishments across collision repair.
paras.zh: 从行业资深人士到后起之秀，当晚将聚焦碰撞修复领域的杰出成就。

paras.en: The program brings together recognition programs from BodyShop Business, CIC, the Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF), FenderBender and ABRN, I-CAR, the National Auto Body Council (NABC), and SCRS.
paras.zh: 该计划汇集了来自 BodyShop Business、CIC、碰撞修复教育基金会 (CREF)、FenderBender 和 ABRN、I-CAR、国家汽车车身委员会 (NABC) 和 SCRS 的认可计划。

paras.en: Andy Tylka of TAG Auto Group will host the evening and guide attendees through a lineup of award presentations.
paras.zh: TAG Auto Group 的 Andy Tylka 将主持晚会并指导与会者进行一系列颁奖典礼。

paras.en: Awards presented during the evening will include:
paras.zh: 当晚颁发的奖项将包括：

paras.en: - Jeff Silver Memorial Award — Platinum Individual
paras.zh: - 杰夫·西尔弗纪念奖——白金个人奖

paras.en: - Russ Verona Memorial Award — Gold Class Shop
paras.zh: - Russ Verona 纪念奖 — 金级商店

paras.en: - Collision Industry Individual Service Award
paras.zh: - 碰撞行业个人服务奖

paras.en: SCRS says the March Taylor Kina’Ole Award honors an individual who exemplifies the Hawaiian principle of Kina’Ole: doing the right thing, in the right way, at the right time, and for the right reasons.
paras.zh: SCRS 表示，三月泰勒 Kina’Ole 奖旨在表彰体现夏威夷 Kina’Ole 原则的个人：以正确的方式、在正确的时间、以正确的理由做正确的事。

paras.en: The award celebrates the legacy of March Taylor, whose commitment to technical excellence, mentorship, and service to others left a lasting impression on the collision repair community and around the SCRS table.
paras.zh: 该奖项旨在表彰 March Taylor 留下的宝贵遗产，他对卓越技术、指导和服务的承诺给碰撞修复界和 SCRS 界留下了持久的印象。

paras.en: It recognizes individuals who demonstrate those same values and passion for doing what is right through their contributions to the industry and the people around them.
paras.zh: 它表彰那些通过对行业和周围人的贡献而表现出同样价值观和做正确事的热情的个人。

paras.en: The theme of the Nov. 3 meeting, to be held in Westgate’s Pavilion 1, is “Customer Impacts.” Chairman Dan Risley will kick off the meeting, followed by incoming chairman Trent Tinsley, who will share his thoughts and goals for 2027.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日会议将于 Westgate 1 号馆举行，主题是“客户影响”。主席丹·里斯利 (Dan Risley) 将为会议拉开序幕，随后候任主席特伦特·廷斯利 (Trent Tinsley) 将分享他对 2027 年的想法和目标。

paras.en: Attendees will hear from CIC’s Governmental and Estimating and Repair Planning committees on AI disclosure in the repair and claims process and on submitting technical inquiries.
paras.zh: 与会者将听取 CIC 政府委员会、评估和维修规划委员会关于维修和索赔流程中人工智能披露以及提交技术查询的意见。

paras.en: CIC says the Governmental Committee members will discuss documenting AI’s role, identifying who changed or approved an estimate, and making sure a qualified person can review decisions that affect payment or vehicle safety. Estimating and Repair Planning Committee members will break down how to craft and submit clear, complete technical inquiries to OEMs and estimating databases, according to CIC’s agenda.
paras.zh: CIC 表示，政府委员会成员将讨论记录人工智能的作用，确定谁更改或批准了估算，并确保合格人员可以审查影响付款或车辆安全的决策。根据 CIC 的议程，评估和维修计划委员会成员将详细说明如何向 OEM 和评估数据库制定并向 OEM 和评估数据库提交清晰、完整的技术查询。

paras.en: The Industry Exchange, a podcast-esque portion of CIC’s meetings with Aaron Schulenburg, will include Kristin Dziczek, senior policy advisor for the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago. The agenda lists her as one of the nation’s leading voices on the economic forces shaping the automotive industry.
paras.zh: 行业交流是 CIC 与 Aaron Schulenburg 会议的播客式部分，芝加哥联邦储备银行高级政策顾问 Kristin Dziczek 将出席。该议程将她列为美国塑造汽车行业经济力量的主要代言人之一。

paras.en: Dziczek’s research focuses on transportation and is backed by decades of experience studying automotive manufacturing, labor, supply chains, policy, and technology, according to the agenda. Earlier this year, Dziczek described the 2025 auto industry as a shock absorber during the Automotive Insights Symposium.
paras.zh: 根据议程，齐切克的研究重点是交通运输，并以数十年研究汽车制造、劳动力、供应链、政策和技术的经验为后盾。今年早些时候，Dziczek 在汽车洞察研讨会上将 2025 年汽车行业描述为减震器。

paras.en: The OEM Industry Relations Committee plans to discuss how post-COVID economic and technological shifts are affecting aftermarket repair quality, warranty implications, and customer satisfaction. They’ll also go over strategies for OEMs to support repair readiness, manage repair costs, and maintain brand loyalty in an increasingly complex market.
paras.zh: OEM 行业关系委员会计划讨论新冠疫情后的经济和技术转变如何影响售后维修质量、保修影响和客户满意度。他们还将讨论 OEM 厂商支持维修准备、管理维修成本以及在日益复杂的市场中保持品牌忠诚度的策略。

paras.en: Next, the Parts & Materials Committee will talk about how vehicle-specific consumables, as critical components of the OEM repair process, directly influence repair quality, safety, and compliance.
paras.zh: 接下来，零部件材料委员会将讨论车辆专用消耗品作为主机厂维修流程的关键组成部分，如何直接影响维修质量、安全性和合规性。

paras.en: In a game of “Family Feud,” the Business Operations and Management Committee will cover retirement and exit planning for shop owners, whether through succession, management buyouts, employee stock ownership plans, or sale.
paras.zh: 在“家族争斗”游戏中，业务运营和管理委员会将负责店主的退休和退出计划，无论是通过继承、管理层收购、员工持股计划还是出售。

paras.en: To close out committee presentations, Repair Process and Procedures will lead a panel discussion to showcase the details of what today’s modern collision repair facilities face in replicating modern, technical OEM finishes.
paras.zh: 为了结束委员会的演讲，维修流程和程序将主持小组讨论，展示当今现代碰撞维修设施在复制现代技术 OEM 饰面时所面临的细节。

paras.en: A special presentation on the 2026 SEMA Show New Products Showcase entries and winners, including personal favorites from CIC leaders, will wrap up the meeting.
paras.zh: 会议将特别介绍 2026 年 SEMA 展会新产品展示参赛作品和获奖者，其中包括 CIC 领导人的个人最爱。

paras.en: To register for CIC, follow this link. Regular registration is $125.
paras.zh: 要注册 CIC，请点击此链接。常规注册费用为 125 美元。

paras.en: Featured image: A Talent Pool & Education Committee panel during the July 22, 2026, CIC meeting in Chicago. (RDN file photo)
paras.zh: 特色图片：2026 年 7 月 22 日在芝加哥举行的 CIC 会议上的人才库和教育委员会小组。 （RDN档案照片）

paras.en: Tim Ronak and his family in 2025, when Ronak received the March Taylor Kina’ole Award. (RDN file photo)
paras.zh: 2025 年，蒂姆·罗纳克 (Tim Ronak) 和他的家人，当时罗纳克获得了三月泰勒·基纳奥尔奖 (March Taylor Kina’ole Award)。 （RDN档案照片）

articles.title: Alignment Specs: 2021–Current Ford Mustang Mach-E
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The Mustang Mach-E uses Ford’s Global Electrified 1 (GE1) platform, a heavily reworked version of the automaker’s C2 architecture. The C2 platform also underpins the fourth-generation Ford Focus and third-generation Kuga, as well as the fourth-generation Escape. While the Mach-E shares its platform lineage with these vehicles, GE1 was adapted for an all-electric SUV. That platform connection provides useful context for technicians approaching its suspension and alignment service, while vehicle-specific procedures and specifications remain essential across model years and configurations.
paras.zh: Mustang Mach-E 使用福特的 Global Electrified 1 (GE1) 平台，这是该汽车制造商 C2 架构的经过大量修改的版本。 C2 平台还支持第四代福特福克斯、第三代 Kuga 以及第四代 Escape。虽然 Mach-E 与这些车辆共享其平台血统，但 GE1 适合于全电动 SUV。该平台连接为技术人员提供悬架和定位服务提供了有用的背景，而车辆特定的程序和规范在不同型号年份和配置中仍然至关重要。

paras.en: The Mustang Mach-E has adjustable camber and toe at both ends, but an alignment service with this car also calls for attention to the vehicle loading, ride height and driver-assistance systems. The procedures provided in this article are for a 2023 AWD Mach-E, so confirm the specifications and service procedure for the vehicle’s exact model year and configuration before making adjustments. The supplied information does not include numerical alignment specifications or acceptable ride-height ranges.
paras.zh: 野马 Mach-E 两端的外倾角和前束均可调节，但该车的对准服务还需要注意车辆负载、行驶高度和驾驶员辅助系统。本文提供的程序适用于 2023 年 AWD Mach-E，因此在进行调整之前请确认车辆的确切型号年份和配置的规格和维修程序。提供的信息不包括数字对准规范或可接受的行驶高度范围。

paras.en: Before measuring toe, Ford’s procedure calls for a level surface, correct tire pressure, and an inspection for tire wear, damage and suspension wear or damage. The steering wheel must be held straight ahead with a suitable holding device during the toe checks.
paras.zh: 在测量前束之前，福特的程序要求地面平整、轮胎压力正确，并检查轮胎磨损、损坏和悬架磨损或损坏。在检查前束时，必须使用合适的固定装置将方向盘保持在正前方。

paras.en: Ride-height measurement has additional preparation requirements. Position the vehicle on a flat, level surface with tires inflated to the correct pressure. The procedure specifies a full tank of fuel, proper fluid levels and no cargo in the cabin or bed. Inspect for aftermarket equipment and changes to steering, suspension, wheels or tires, then jounce the front and rear suspension vigorously to let the vehicle settle.
paras.zh: 行驶高度测量有额外的准备要求。将车辆放置在平坦的水平表面上，轮胎充气至正确的压力。该程序规定燃油箱已满、液位适当且客舱或床上不得有货物。检查售后设备以及转向、悬架、车轮或轮胎的变化，然后用力摇晃前后悬架，让车辆稳定下来。

paras.en: Remember: Alignment readings are only useful when the vehicle is in the specified condition. If ride height is incorrect, look for changes or problems in the suspension and review the vehicle’s service information before treating alignment adjustments as the solution.
paras.zh: 请记住：对准读数仅在车辆处于指定条件时才有用。如果行驶高度不正确，请查找悬架的变化或问题，并查看车辆的维修信息，然后再将定位调整作为解决方案。

paras.en: If you find that you can’t get the vehicle to roll to carry out the rolling compensation measurements, this is because it has Rollaway Protection Mode that activates when the car is turned off and the driver exits. To enable the car to roll, you will have to leave it on and in neutral during the alignment. In some cases, you might want to attach the driver seatbelt and roll the door latch to prevent it from going into park.
paras.zh: 如果您发现无法让车辆滚动以进行滚动补偿测量，这是因为它具有滚动保护模式，该模式会在汽车关闭且驾驶员退出时激活。为了使汽车能够滚动，您必须在对准过程中将其保持在空档位置。在某些情况下，您可能需要系上驾驶员安全带并滚动车门闩锁以防止其进入停车位。

paras.en: Front camber is adjusted at the strut-to-knuckle connection. First, measure camber with alignment equipment, then remove the wheels and tires. The brake flexible hose is unbolted and moved aside, and the wheel knuckle is supported with mechanic’s wire.
paras.zh: 前外倾角在支柱到转向节的连接处进行调整。首先，用定位设备测量外倾角，然后拆下车轮和轮胎。松开制动软管并移到一边，车轮转向节用机械钢丝支撑。

paras.en: The original strut-to-knuckle bolts and nuts are removed and discarded. Ford specifies new service bolts and nuts for reassembly. The service fasteners are smooth and smaller in diameter than the splined original equipment bolts. With the new fasteners installed and snug, move the knuckle inboard or outboard to bring camber into specification. The procedure states that moving from the maximum inboard to maximum outboard position provides 0.5 degree of adjustment.
paras.zh: 原来的支柱到转向节的螺栓和螺母被拆除并丢弃。福特指定了用于重新组装的新维修螺栓和螺母。维修紧固件光滑且直径小于带花键的原始设备螺栓。安装新紧固件并使其紧贴后，将转向节向内或向外移动，使外倾角符合规格。该程序规定，从最大内侧位置移动到最大外侧位置可提供 0.5 度的调整。

paras.en: Do not fully tighten the strut-to-knuckle fasteners until camber is corrected. After adjustment, torque the bolts and nuts to 173 lb.-ft. (235 Nm). Reinstall the brake hose and torque its bolt to 97 lb.-in. (11 Nm). Reinstall the wheels and tires, recheck alignment and adjust front toe if needed. Because changing camber can affect toe, finish by verifying the toe readings.
paras.zh: 在外倾角得到纠正之前，请勿完全拧紧支柱至转向节的紧固件。调整后，将螺栓和螺母拧紧至 173 磅英尺。 （235 牛米）。重新安装制动软管并将其螺栓拧紧至 97 磅英寸。 （11 纳米）。重新安装车轮和轮胎，重新检查对准情况并根据需要调整前束。由于改变外倾角会影响前束，因此最后要验证前束读数。

paras.en: Front toe is adjusted at the inner tie rods. With the steering wheel held straight, check toe on both sides. Hold each outer tie-rod end stationary while loosening its jam nut; Ford cautions that allowing the tie-rod end to turn can damage the boot. Move the steering gear boot clamp aside, then rotate the inner tie rod to adjust toe. Do not let the steering gear bellows twist as the inner tie rod turns. Recheck toe after adjustment and road test the vehicle.
paras.zh: 前束通过内横拉杆进行调节。保持方向盘伸直，检查两侧前束。松开锁紧螺母时，保持每个外横拉杆端部固定；福特警告说，让横拉杆末端转动可能会损坏行李箱。将舵机靴夹移到一边，然后旋转内横拉杆调整前束。请勿让转向器波纹管随着内拉杆的转动而扭转。调整后重新检查前束并对车辆进行路试。

paras.en: Rear camber is adjusted by moving the upper control arm at its inboard mounting point. Measure camber, loosen the inboard nut approximately two turns, then slide the control arm inboard or outboard to change the reading. Recheck the alignment to verify the change and adjust rear toe if needed. The supplied procedure lists a torque of 76 lb.-ft. (103 Nm) for the upper control arm inboard nut.
paras.zh: 通过移动内侧安装点的上控制臂来调整后外倾角。测量外倾角，松开内侧螺母大约两圈，然后向内或向外滑动控制臂以更改读数。重新检查对齐情况以验证更改并根据需要调整后束。提供的程序列出了 76 磅-英尺的扭矩。 (103 Nm) 用于上控制臂内侧螺母。

paras.en: Rear toe is adjusted at the toe link. With the steering wheel held straight ahead, measure toe on both sides. Before turning the toe-link bolt, clean the area around the joint using mild liquids. Ford notes that the cam nut and cam bolt area must be free of foreign material for proper clamping. Loosen the toe-link nut approximately one turn, rotate the toe-link bolt to obtain the specified reading, and tighten without disturbing the setting. The procedure lists 66 lb.-ft. (90 Nm) for the toe-link nut.
paras.zh: 后束角在束角处进行调节。将方向盘保持笔直向前，测量两侧的前束角。转动趾连杆螺栓之前，请使用温和的液体清洁接头周围的区域。福特指出，凸轮螺母和凸轮螺栓区域必须没有异物才能正确夹紧。松开趾连杆螺母大约一圈，旋转趾连杆螺栓以获得指定读数，然后在不干扰设置的情况下拧紧。该程序列出了 66 磅英尺。 (90 Nm) 用于趾连杆螺母。

paras.en: If the Mach-E is equipped with Lane Departure Warning, Ford requires an IPMA camera alignment after rear toe adjustment. Connect a scan tool and follow its directions for the camera alignment procedure. Road test after the adjustment and required camera service.
paras.zh: 如果 Mach-E 配备车道偏离警告，福特需要在后束调整后进行 IPMA 摄像头对准。连接扫描工具并按照其说明进行相机对准过程。调整后的路试和所需的相机服务。

paras.en: The supplied ride-height procedure uses a surface gauge to measure from a flat, level surface to suspension reference points. At the front, measure from the surface to the center of the lower arm forward bolt and to the center of the ball-joint pinch bolt. Subtract the lower-arm forward-bolt measurement from the ball-joint pinch-bolt measurement to calculate front ride height.
paras.zh: 提供的行驶高度程序使用表面测量仪来测量从平坦的水平表面到悬架参考点的距离。在前面，从表面到下臂前部螺栓的中心以及球形接头压紧螺栓的中心进行测量。从球窝接头压紧螺栓测量值中减去下臂前向螺栓测量值，即可计算前部行驶高度。

paras.en: At the rear, measure from the surface to the center of the lower arm-to-subframe bolt and to the center of the lower arm-to-wheel-knuckle bolt. For the rear, subtract the wheel-knuckle-bolt measurement from the subframe-bolt measurement.
paras.zh: 在后部，从表面到下臂到副车架螺栓的中心以及下臂到车轮转向节螺栓的中心进行测量。对于后部，从副车架螺栓测量值中减去车轮转向节螺栓测量值。

paras.en: The service information provided describes how to take these measurements but does not give target ride-height values. Use the correct model-year service information for the vehicle to determine whether the recorded measurements are within specification. Avoid substituting a visual estimate or a generic ride-height value.
paras.zh: 提供的服务信息描述了如何进行这些测量，但没有给出目标行驶高度值。使用车辆的正确型号年份服务信息来确定记录的测量值是否符合规格。避免用视觉估计或通用行驶高度值代替。

paras.en: The vehicle’s service information shows a headlamp level sensor at both the front and rear suspension. The front sensor is mounted at the left front suspension, with its arm bracket attached to the lower arm. The rear sensor is also mounted at the left side, with its arm bracket attached to the lower arm. Each has an electrical connector.
paras.zh: 车辆的维修信息显示前悬架和后悬架上都有前照灯水平传感器。前传感器安装在左前悬架上，其臂支架连接到下臂。后传感器也安装在左侧，其臂支架连接到下臂。每个都有一个电连接器。

paras.en: During a suspension or alignment inspection, check that the sensors, brackets, arms and wiring are present and undamaged. The supplied procedure covers sensor removal and installation, but it does not specify an adjustment or calibration following a wheel alignment. If a sensor or its linkage has been disturbed or damaged, consult the correct service information for the required repair steps.
paras.zh: 在悬挂或对准检查期间，检查传感器、支架、臂和接线是否存在且未损坏。提供的程序涵盖了传感器的拆卸和安装，但没有指定车轮定位后的调整或校准。如果传感器或其连杆受到干扰或损坏，请查阅正确的服务信息以了解所需的维修步骤。

articles.title: PRI 2026 Education Program Promises Expert Insights
articles.author: Greg Jones

paras.en: Performance Racing Industry (PRI) will offer a range of educational opportunities at the 2026 PRI Show, Dec. 10-12, at the Indiana Convention Center and Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. The program will cover business strategies, motorsports engineering and career development, with sessions designed for professionals at different stages of their careers.
paras.zh: Performance Racing Industry (PRI) 将于 12 月 10 日至 12 日在印第安纳州会议中心和印第安纳波利斯卢卡斯石油体育场举行的 2026 PRI 展上提供一系列教育机会。该项目将涵盖商业战略、赛车运动工程和职业发展，并为处于职业生涯不同阶段的专业人士设计课程。

paras.en: Friday, Dec. 11, will feature PRI Education sessions addressing key business and technical challenges facing motorsports, including:
paras.zh: 12 月 11 日星期五，将举办 PRI 教育会议，解决赛车运动面临的关键业务和技术挑战，包括：

paras.en: - Using Tribology to Find Extra Horsepower (9 a.m.): Peter Lee of Southwest Research Institute and Lake Speed Jr. of SPEEDiagnostix will explain how reducing friction can improve engine and drivetrain performance.
paras.zh: - 利用摩擦学寻找额外马力（上午 9 点）：西南研究所的 Peter Lee 和 SPEEDiagnostix 的 Lake Speed Jr. 将解释减少摩擦如何提高发动机和传动系统的性能。

paras.en: - State of the Racing Market (11 a.m.): PRI Director of Market Research Gavin Knapp will discuss new research on industry performance, market conditions and business expectations.
paras.zh: - 赛马市场状况（上午 11 点）：PRI 市场研究总监 Gavin Knapp 将讨论有关行业表现、市场状况和业务预期的新研究。

paras.en: - How a Culture Can Cure Your Crew Needs (1 p.m.): Tom Shay of Profits Plus Solutions will share strategies for attracting employees, improving retention and building a stronger workplace culture.
paras.zh: - 文化如何满足您的员工需求（下午 1 点）：Profits Plus Solutions 的 Tom Shay 将分享吸引员工、提高保留率和建立更强大的工作场所文化的策略。

paras.en: - Using AI for Sponsorships (3 p.m.): Alex Striler of SponsorshipTactics.com will explore how racers can use artificial intelligence to strengthen their sponsorship programs.
paras.zh: - 使用人工智能进行赞助（下午 3 点）：SponsorshipTactics.com 的 Alex Striler 将探讨赛车手如何使用人工智能来加强他们的赞助计划。

paras.en: The inaugural PRI Motorsports Engineering Symposium will expand the PRI Show’s educational offerings Thursday, Dec. 10, with technical discussions on simulation, powertrain development, materials, manufacturing and workforce development. The program will feature experts from IndyCar, Purdue University and Motor State Distributing and is open to all registered PRI Show attendees at no additional cost.
paras.zh: 首届 PRI 赛车运动工程研讨会将于 12 月 10 日星期四扩大 PRI Show 的教育内容，包括有关模拟、动力总成开发、材料、制造和劳动力发展的技术讨论。该计划将邀请来自 IndyCar、普渡大学和 Motor State Distributing 的专家参加，并向所有注册 PRI Show 与会者开放，无需支付额外费用。

paras.en: New for 2026, NextGen Connect presented by Carlyle Tools will help students and young adults explore motorsports careers through educational sessions, networking, resume reviews and career guidance. The program will also feature daily Lunch & Learn sessions covering professional branding, apprenticeships and internships, and career paths in motorsports. The NextGen Connect Breakfast on Saturday, Dec. 12, will feature a keynote address from Hendrick Motorsports Director of Technical Partnerships Alba Colon.

paras.en: To register and learn more, visit PRI2026.com/Attend. PRI membership is no longer required to attend. For more information, visit PerformanceRacing.com.
paras.zh: 要注册并了解更多信息，请访问 PRI2026.com/Atend。 PRI 会员不再需要参加。欲了解更多信息，请访问 PerformanceRacing.com。

articles.title: Automotive Parts Headquarters Raises $513K for WACOSA
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Automotive Parts Headquarters Inc. (APH), together with its supplier partners and the Bartlett family, raised $513,000 through its annual fundraiser benefiting WACOSA, a central Minnesota nonprofit serving adults with disabilities. The 2026 event brings the fundraiser’s 14-year total to $3.7 million.
paras.zh: Automotive Parts Headhead Inc. (APH) 与其供应商合作伙伴和 Bartlett 家族一起，通过其年度筹款活动筹集了 513,000 美元，惠及 WACOSA，这是一家为残疾人服务的明尼苏达州中部非营利组织。 2026 年的活动使该活动 14 年来的筹款总额达到 370 万美元。

paras.en: Proceeds support WACOSA programs that provide meaningful employment, day services and opportunities for more than 650 adults with disabilities across central Minnesota.
paras.zh: 收益将用于支持 WACOSA 项目，为明尼苏达州中部地区 650 多名残疾成年人提供有意义的就业、日间服务和机会。

paras.en: The event began with a walleye shore lunch and guided tours of WACOSA before attendees gathered at APH’s newest facility (a bulk storage warehouse) in St. Cloud for a pie and ice cream social celebrating its grand opening and APH’s “Building Our Future Together” initiative.
paras.zh: 活动以白眼鱼岸边午餐和 WCOSA 导游带领开始，然后与会者聚集在 APH 位于圣克劳德的最新设施（散装仓储仓库），参加馅饼和冰淇淋社交活动，庆祝其盛大开业和 APH 的“共创未来”倡议。

paras.en: Attendees also participated in a hands-on art experience led by WACOSA artist-in-residence Dan Mondloch. The individual pieces created during the event will be incorporated into a collaborative collage inspired by the northern lights above a Minnesota lake.
paras.zh: 与会者还参加了由 WACOSA 驻场艺术家 Dan Mondloch 主持的艺术实践体验。活动期间创作的个人作品将被纳入灵感来自明尼苏达州湖上北极光的合作拼贴画中。

paras.en: “The day captured so much of what makes this event special,” said Jason Vogel, president of APH Stores Inc. “Bringing our supplier partners, employees and friends together to experience WACOSA’s mission firsthand, celebrate a new chapter for APH and create something together was incredibly rewarding.”
paras.zh: APH Stores Inc. 总裁杰森·沃格尔 (Jason Vogel) 表示：“这一天体现了本次活动的特别之处。将我们的供应商合作伙伴、员工和朋友聚集在一起，亲身体验 WACOSA 的使命、庆祝 APH 翻开新篇章并共同创造一些东西，这是令人难以置信的回报。”

paras.en: The day concluded with a cocktail reception, lobster-themed dinner and awards ceremony hosted by John and Nancy Bartlett at their home. A highlight of the evening was the presentation of a $513,000 check to Nancy Betts, executive director of WACOSA.
paras.zh: 约翰·巴特利特 (John Bartlett) 和南希·巴特利特 (Nancy Bartlett) 在他们家中举办了鸡尾酒会、龙虾主题晚宴和颁奖典礼，结束了这一天。当晚的一大亮点是向WACOSA 执行董事Nancy Betts 赠送了一张513,000 美元的支票。

paras.en: “Fourteen years of support from APH, its supplier partners and the Bartlett family has created a remarkable legacy for the people we serve,” Betts said. “This generosity creates opportunities for people to discover their strengths, contribute to their communities and pursue greater independence. We are deeply grateful for the lasting difference this partnership makes.”
paras.zh: “APH、其供应商合作伙伴和 Bartlett 家族十四年的支持为我们服务的人们创造了非凡的遗产，”贝茨说。 “这种慷慨为人们创造了发现自己的优势、为社区做出贡献并追求更大独立的机会。我们对这种伙伴关系所带来的持久影响深表感谢。”

paras.en: Corey Bartlett, CEO and owner of APH, said the event reflects the generosity and commitment of the automotive aftermarket community.
paras.zh: APH 首席执行官兼所有者科里·巴特利特 (Corey Bartlett) 表示，此次活动体现了汽车售后市场社区的慷慨和承诺。

paras.en: “Every year, this event reminds us of the extraordinary generosity within the automotive aftermarket,” Bartlett said. “What began as a fundraiser has grown into a lasting partnership between APH, our supplier community and WACOSA. Seeing everyone come together to support the people and mission at the heart of WACOSA is what makes this event so meaningful.”
paras.zh: “每年，这一活动都会提醒我们汽车售后市场的非凡慷慨，”巴特利特说。 “最初的筹款活动现已发展成为 APH、我们的供应商社区和 WACOSA 之间的持久合作伙伴关系。看到每个人齐心协力支持 WACOSA 的人民和使命，这使得这次活动如此有意义。”

paras.en: To view highlights from this year’s event, including the celebration, collaborative art project and messages from industry leaders, visit https://vimeo.com/autopartshq/wacosa26.
paras.zh: 要查看今年活动的亮点，包括庆祝活动、合作艺术项目和行业领袖的信息，请访问 https://vimeo.com/autopartshq/wacosa26。

articles.title: Read ShopOwner’s October Digital Edition Now
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: The interactive and easy-to-use digital edition of ShopOwner’s October issue is available now.
paras.zh: ShopOwner 十月号的交互式且易于使用的数字版现已推出。

paras.en: What happens when some of North America’s best automotive technicians gather in Detroit to compete for the title of 2026 Auto Value and Bumper to Bumper Technician of the Year? There are challenging diagnostic exercises, timed competitions and plenty of pressure, but something even more interesting emerges: camaraderie, mutual respect and a shared passion for solving problems. From military veterans and former electronics technicians to third-generation automotive professionals, this year’s finalists demonstrate that there’s no single road to success in the automotive service industry. Ultimately, Matt Wagg of Accelerated Diagnostic & Automotive in Bennington, NE, earned the U.S. championship, while Jake McKie and Roberto Chávez Chairez claimed the Canadian and Latin American honors.
paras.zh: 当北美一些最优秀的汽车技术人员齐聚底特律，争夺 2026 年汽车价值和年度最佳技术人员称号时，会发生什么？这里有具有挑战性的诊断练习、定时竞赛和巨大的压力，但更有趣的东西出现了：友情、相互尊重和解决问题的共同热情。从退伍军人、前电子技术人员到第三代汽车专业人士，今年的决赛入围者证明，汽车服务行业没有单一的成功之路。最终，内布拉斯加州本宁顿 Accelerated Diagnostic & Automotive 公司的 Matt Wagg 赢得了美国冠军，而 Jake McKie 和 Roberto Chávez Chairez 则获得了加拿大和拉丁美洲的荣誉。

paras.en: But the real story goes well beyond the winners. Through candid conversations with the finalists, a powerful message emerges about mentorship, ongoing training, professional pride and the importance of recognizing technicians for the work they do every day. Their experiences offer valuable lessons for shop owners looking to develop and retain great employees while building stronger businesses. Read the complete article to meet these outstanding professionals, discover the people and experiences that shaped their careers, and learn why the greatest reward of this competition may have nothing to do with taking home a trophy.
paras.zh: 但真实的故事远远超出了获胜者的范围。通过与决赛入围者的坦诚对话，关于指导、持续培训、职业自豪感以及认可技术人员日常工作的重要性的强有力的信息浮现出来。他们的经验为希望培养和留住优秀员工、同时打造更强大企业的店主提供了宝贵的经验教训。阅读完整的文章来认识这些杰出的专业人士，了解塑造他们职业生涯的人物和经历，并了解为什么本次比赛的最大奖励可能与带回家奖杯无关。

paras.en: PLUS, you’ll find Tech Tips, new products, editorial commentary and technical content from ImportCar Brake & Front End, Underhood Service, TechShop and Tire Review, all ShopOwner channels.
paras.zh: 另外，您还可以找到来自 ImportCar Brake & Front End、Underhood Service、TechShop 和 Tire Review 以及所有 ShopOwner 频道的技术提示、新产品、编辑评论和技术内容。

articles.title: PRT to Showcase New Light Commercial Vehicle Line at AAPEX
articles.author: ImportCar Staff Writers

paras.en: PRT announced that it will be showcasing its new light commercial vehicle (LCV) line, among other products, at AAPEX 2026. The company will exhibit at the Venetian Expo in booth F14600.
paras.zh: PRT 宣布将在 AAPEX 2026 上展示其新型轻型商用车 (LCV) 系列及其他产品。该公司将在威尼斯世博会的 F14600 展位上展出。

paras.en: The company also will present its air shocks, top mounts and motor mounts product lines. Its heavy-duty portfolio includes applications for trucks, trailers, buses, commercial vehicles, cement mixers and motorhomes.
paras.zh: 该公司还将展示其空气减震器、顶部安装件和电机安装件产品线。其重型产品组合包括卡车、拖车、公共汽车、商用车、水泥搅拌机和房车的应用。

paras.en: “We’re more than happy to introduce our new LCV line and showcase our multiple product lines at AAPEX 2026,” said Bruno Bello of PRT. “Our ongoing investments in manufacturing technology and OE-quality engineering support the continued development of solutions for the North American aftermarket.”
paras.zh: PRT 的 Bruno Bello 表示：“我们非常高兴在 AAPEX 2026 上推出我们新的轻型商用车系列并展示我们的多个产品线。” “我们对制造技术和原厂质量工程的持续投资支持北美售后市场解决方案的持续开发。”

articles.title: Bright object beyond Pluto may be the solar system's sixth dwarf planet
articles.author: Damien Pine

paras.en: The Vera C. Rubin Observatory has found what might be a tiny new world in the far reaches of our solar system, hidden beyond the orbit of Neptune — and it is among the largest and brightest objects ever discovered beyond Neptune.
paras.zh: 维拉·C·鲁宾天文台在太阳系遥远的地方发现了一个可能是一个微小的新世界，隐藏在海王星轨道之外——它是迄今为止在海王星之外发现的最大、最亮的天体之一。

paras.en: If confirmed, the miniature world would increase the number of officially recognized solar system dwarf planets to six. Upper estimates of the object's size place it at more than half the diameter of Pluto, the largest known dwarf planet.
paras.zh: 如果得到证实，这个微型世界将使官方认可的太阳系矮行星数量增加到六颗。对这个物体大小的较高估计表明它的直径超过已知最大的矮行星冥王星直径的一半。

paras.en: "My first reaction was one of excited disbelief," Matthew Holman, an astrophysicist at the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory and member of the Rubin team who wrote the code that helped discover the prospective dwarf planet, said in a statement. "Objects like this are very rare, so I immediately started checking whether I or the code had done something wrong."
paras.zh: “我的第一反应是兴奋和难以置信，”史密森天体物理天文台的天体物理学家马修·霍尔曼（Matthew Holman）在一份声明中说，他是鲁宾团队的成员，他编写了帮助发现这颗潜在矮行星的代码。 “这样的对象非常罕见，所以我立即开始检查我或代码是否做错了什么。”

paras.en: The potential dwarf planet, designated 2026 ED138, orbits the sun at roughly 46 times the distance between Earth and the sun. The potential new planetoid has been hiding behind galactic camouflage; with its orbit tilted at a 25-degree angle from the solar system plane, it's at just the right angle to get lost in the light from the inner Milky Way, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 这颗潜在的矮行星被命名为 2026 ED138，绕太阳公转的距离约为地球与太阳之间距离的 46 倍。潜在的新小行星一直隐藏在银河伪装后面。研究人员表示，它的轨道与太阳系平面成 25 度角，因此它的角度正好适合迷失在来自银河系内部的光线中。

paras.en: Many telescopes struggle to see past the millions of stars making up our galaxy's bulge. The Vera C. Rubin Observatory, however, images the entire southern sky every few nights with the largest digital camera ever built, sending out millions of nightly alerts for every object that has changed brightness or position. This makes it exceptional at identifying anything that moves, from solar system objects to transient events like supernova explosions.
paras.zh: 许多望远镜都很难看到构成银河系核球的数百万颗恒星。然而，维拉·C·鲁宾天文台每隔几个晚上就会用有史以来最大的数码相机对整个南方天空进行成像，针对每个亮度或位置发生变化的物体发出数百万个夜间警报。这使得它在识别任何移动的物体方面表现出色，从太阳系物体到超新星爆炸等瞬态事件。

paras.en: The observatory had only just begun its 10-year mission of scanning the sky in July, and ED138 stood out in the data.
paras.zh: 该天文台在 7 月份才刚刚开始其为期 10 年的天空扫描任务，ED138 在数据中脱颖而出。

paras.en: Holman works on the software algorithms that process the extreme amounts of data the observatory collects. The code he developed with his colleague, Kevin Napier, compares billions of observations to determine which ones are detections of the same moving object. Running data from Rubin through the code revealed the unusually large object.
paras.zh: 霍尔曼致力于研究处理天文台收集的大量数据的软件算法。他与同事 Kevin Napier 开发的代码比较了数十亿次观察结果，以确定哪些是对同一移动物体的检测。通过代码运行 Rubin 的数据发现了这个异常大的物体。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: By looking at past data from Rubin and archival images from the Dark Energy Camera mounted on the Victor M. Blanco 4-meter Telescope at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (both in Chile), the team was able to map out ED138's orbit over the past 10 years.
paras.zh: 通过查看鲁宾过去的数据和安装在托洛洛山美洲天文台 Victor M. Blanco 4 米望远镜（均位于智利）上的暗能量相机的档案图像，该团队能够绘制出 ED138 在过去 10 年的轨道。

paras.en: The Kuiper Belt is a region of the solar system beyond Neptune that is a wild frontier of small, mostly icy bodies made from frozen methane, ammonia, water and rock. It ranges from roughly 30 to 50 times the distance between Earth and the sun, and is home to most of the known dwarf planets, including Pluto. Thousands of Kuiper Belt objects have already been discovered. These space rocks can be frozen time capsules that hold clues about the early solar system's formation.
paras.zh: 柯伊伯带是太阳系海王星以外的一个区域，是由冰冻甲烷、氨、水和岩石组成的小型、大部分冰体组成的狂野边界。它的范围约为地球与太阳之间距离的 30 至 50 倍，是大多数已知矮行星的所在地，包括冥王星。已经发现了数千个柯伊伯带天体。这些太空岩石可以是冻结的时间胶囊，其中保存着有关早期太阳系形成的线索。

paras.en: Dwarf planets are the largest Kuiper Belt objects that we know of. Bigger than asteroids but not quite planets, dwarf planets are big enough to be rounded under the force of their own gravity but too small to clear their orbits like planets do. While the International Astronomical Union (IAU) has officially confirmed five dwarf planets — Pluto, Ceres, Eris, Haumea and Makemake — astronomers studying dwarf planets often recognize at least nine, with several more candidates whose properties are still unknown.
paras.zh: 矮行星是我们所知最大的柯伊伯带天体。矮行星比小行星大，但不完全是行星，它们足够大，可以在自身引力的作用下呈圆形，但又太小，无法像行星那样绕行轨道。虽然国际天文学联合会 (IAU) 已正式确认了五颗矮行星——冥王星、谷神星、阋神星、豪美亚和鸟神星，但研究矮行星的天文学家通常会识别出至少九颗，还有几颗属性仍未知的候选行星。

paras.en: Depending on which astronomer you ask, there could be anywhere from a handful to hundreds of dwarf planets in this part of the solar system. Identifying which Kuiper Belt objects are dwarf planets is tricky because they are often very dim and move very slowly from Earth's perspective, since their orbits are so large and distant. The likeliest candidates have high albedo (surface reflectivity) and diameters greater than roughly 370 to 500 miles (600 to 800 km).
paras.zh: 根据您询问的天文学家的不同，太阳系的这一部分可能存在少量到数百颗矮行星。识别哪些柯伊伯带天体是矮行星是很棘手的，因为它们的轨道又大又远，从地球的角度来看它们通常非常暗淡并且移动非常缓慢。最有可能的候选者具有高反照率（表面反射率）和直径大于约 370 至 500 英里（600 至 800 公里）。

paras.en: What makes ED138 special is its size, inferred from its brightness, albedo and distance from the sun. It's estimated to have a diameter between 370 to 930 miles (600 to 1,500 km). For comparison, Pluto — the largest dwarf planet recognized by the IAU — is 1,477 miles (2,377 km) in diameter. Ceres, the smallest IAU-recognized dwarf planet, is 595 miles (958 km) in diameter. Future observations of ED138 will give researchers a more accurate idea of its diameter and density to determine if it's round enough to join the dwarf planet club.
paras.zh: ED138 的特殊之处在于其尺寸，这是根据其亮度、反照率和距太阳的距离推断出来的。据估计，它的直径在 370 至 930 英里（600 至 1,500 公里）之间。相比之下，冥王星——国际天文学联合会认可的最大矮行星——直径为 1,477 英里（2,377 公里）。谷神星是国际天文学联合会认可的最小矮行星，直径为 595 英里（958 公里）。未来对 ED138 的观测将使研究人员更准确地了解它的直径和密度，以确定它是否足够圆，可以加入矮行星俱乐部。

paras.en: "If confirmed as a dwarf planet, ED138 would join a very small family of worlds," Holman said in the statement. "Rubin will image the whole southern sky again and again for ten years, so any others hiding in the places earlier surveys skipped are now within reach."
paras.zh: 霍尔曼在声明中说：“如果被确认为矮行星，ED138 将加入一个非常小的世界家族。” “鲁宾将在十年内一次又一次地拍摄整个南方天空，因此任何其他躲藏在先前调查跳过的地方的人现在都触手可及。”

paras.en: Damien Pine (he/him) is a freelance writer, artist, and former NASA engineer. He writes about science, physics, tech, art, and other topics with a focus on making complicated ideas accessible. He has a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Connecticut, and he gets really excited every time he sees a cat.
paras.zh: 达米恩·派恩（Damien Pine）（他/他）是一位自由作家、艺术家和前美国宇航局工程师。他撰写的文章涉及科学、物理、技术、艺术和其他主题，重点是让复杂的想法变得容易理解。他拥有康涅狄格大学机械工程学位，每次看到猫他都会非常兴奋。
