articles.title: The Best 2026 Halloween Costumes, From Paris Hilton as Britney Spears to Kim Kardashian as North West
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: It’s that time of year again: Halloween, which means a trick-or-treat bag’s worth of celebrity costumes ranging from spooky to cutesy to pop culture-referencing.
paras.zh: 又到了一年中的这个时候：万圣节，这意味着一袋“不给糖就捣蛋”的名人服装，从怪异到可爱到流行文化参考。

paras.en: That includes the usual suspects, stars who’ve long been showcasing their love of the holiday with increasingly elaborate looks. Paris Hilton returned with another Halloween tribute to her friend and pop icon Britney Spears — which she premiered in photos shared exclusively with Billboard — as well as a wholesome family dress-up borrowed from a beloved Disney princess movie. Janelle Monáe has also gone all out once again ahead of her annual Wondaween festival, and a costume triangle of sorts has emerged between Kim Kardashian, her daughter North West and Natalie Nunn.
paras.zh: 其中包括常见的嫌疑人、明星，他们长期以来一直以越来越精致的造型来展示他们对节日的热爱。帕丽斯·希尔顿 (Paris Hilton) 回归，再次向她的朋友兼流行偶像布兰妮·斯皮尔斯 (Britney Spears) 致敬——这是她在《公告牌》(Billboard) 独家分享的照片中首次亮相的，还有借鉴自一部深受喜爱的迪士尼公主电影的健康家庭装扮。加奈尔·梦奈 (Janelle Monáe) 在一年一度的旺达威节 (Wondaween Festival) 之前也再次全力以赴，金·卡戴珊 (Kim Kardashian)、她的女儿诺丝·韦斯特 (North West) 和娜塔莉·纳恩 (Natalie Nunn) 之间也出现了某种服装三角关系。

paras.en: As for costumes specifically honoring something that happened in 2026, Owen Thiele and Benito Skinner are arguably the front runners with a two-person look that recreated one of the year’s buzziest pop collaborations. (Whether you’re a celebrity or not, there’s still time to pull together a 2026-specific Halloween look — here’s some ideas Billboard put together recently referencing Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl performance, Taylor Swift watching the New York Knicks and more.)
paras.zh: 至于专门纪念 2026 年发生的事情的服装，欧文·蒂勒 (Owen Thiele) 和贝尼托·斯金纳 (Benito Skinner) 无疑是领跑者，他们的两人造型再现了今年最热门的流行合作之一。 （无论您是否是名人，仍然有时间打造 2026 年万圣节造型 - Billboard 最近整理了一些创意，参考了 Bad Bunny 的超级碗表演、泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 观看纽约尼克斯队比赛等内容。）

paras.en: With the next few days bringing more and more ‘stumes leading up to the main event on Saturday (Oct. 31), Billboard is keeping track of all of the best celebrity looks. Whether you’re searching for some last-minute inspo or simply want to check out what the biggest names in entertainment are doing for the holiday this year, keep reading to learn about the best Halloween costumes we’ve seen below — and keep checking back for updates!
paras.zh: 在接下来的几天里，周六（10 月 31 日）的主赛事将有越来越多的粉丝前来关注，Billboard 正在追踪所有最好的名人造型。无论您是在寻找最后一刻的灵感，还是只是想看看今年娱乐界的大腕们都在做什么，请继续阅读以了解我们在下面看到的最好的万圣节服装 - 并不断回来查看更新！

paras.en: - Paris Hilton as Britney Spears Paris Hilton continued her tradition of paying homage to the Princess of Pop for the fourth Halloween in a row, this time dressing up as Britney Spears performing “I’m a Slave 4 U” at the 2001 VMAs. “Britney is not only an icon, but also a dear friend, and I’ll always love celebrating her and the incredible impact she’s had on all of us,” Hilton told Billboard of the look. Later, she’d share a second 2026 costume inspired by Beauty and the Beast that got her whole family involved. See Hilton as Britney Spears here and as Princess Belle alongside her family here.
paras.zh: - 帕丽斯·希尔顿 (Paris Hilton) 饰演布兰妮·斯皮尔斯 (Britney Spears) 帕丽斯·希尔顿 (Paris Hilton) 连续第四个万圣节延续了向流行音乐公主致敬的传统，这一次，她装扮成布兰妮·斯皮尔斯 (Britney Spears) 在 2001 年 VMA 上表演“I'm a Slave 4 U”。 “布兰妮不仅是一个偶像，而且还是一位亲爱的朋友，我将永远喜欢庆祝她以及她对我们所有人产生的令人难以置信的影响，”希尔顿在谈到这一造型时说道。后来，她分享了第二套 2026 年服装，灵感来自《美女与野兽》，这让她的全家人都参与其中。在这里，希尔顿扮演布兰妮·斯皮尔斯，在这里，她扮演贝儿公主和她的家人。

paras.en: - Kim Kardashian as North West Kim Kardashian didn’t have to look farther than her own home for her Halloween 2026 muse, dressing up as daughter North West. The reality star completed her look with a turquoise wig, long nails and goth clothing, either replicas of North’s look or borrowed straight from the source. See Kardashian’s costume here.
paras.zh: - 金·卡戴珊 (Kim Kardashian) 饰演诺丝·韦斯特 (North West) 金·卡戴珊 (Kim Kardashian) 打扮成女儿诺丝·韦斯特 (North West) 的样子，无需走出家门就能找到她的 2026 年万圣节缪斯。这位真人秀明星用绿松石假发、长指甲和哥特服装完成了她的造型，这些服装要么是诺斯造型的复制品，要么是直接从来源借来的。在这里查看卡戴珊的服装。

paras.en: - Natalie Nunn as North West “Uno reverse 🔄 @northwest,” Nunn wrote on Instagram while unveiling her 2026 costume: North West. In response to Kardashian and Ye’s eldest daughter dressing up as her, Nunn repaid the favor by joining Kardashian in dressing up as North in turquoise pigtails and a studded collar. See Nunn as North West here.
paras.zh: - 娜塔莉·纳恩 (Natalie Nunn) 饰演西北 “Uno 逆转🔄 @northwest，”纳恩在 Instagram 上发布她的 2026 年服装：西北 (North West) 时写道。为了回应卡戴珊和叶的大女儿打扮成她的样子，纳恩也加入了卡戴珊的行列，打扮成诺斯，扎着绿松石辫子，戴着镶钉衣领。在这里将纳恩视为西北。

paras.en: - Cyndi Lauper as Ursula Cyndi Lauper joined Bette Midler at the New York Restoration Project’s annual Hulaween gala photo call, sporting a chic Phantom of the Opera-esque masquerade look. Inside the event, Lauper switched into a detailed Ursula costume for a performance of her signature Billboard Hot 100 smash, “Girls Just Want to Have Fun,” which she switched to “Ghouls Just Want to Have Fun” for the occasion.
paras.zh: - 辛迪·劳珀 (Cyndi Lauper) 饰演乌苏拉 (Ursula) 辛迪·劳珀 (Cyndi Lauper) 与贝蒂·米德勒 (Bette Midler) 一起出席纽约修复项目一年一度的 Hulaween 盛大拍照会，一身别致的歌剧魅影式化装舞会造型。在活动中，劳珀换上了精致的乌苏拉服装，表演了她标志性的 Billboard Hot 100 热门单曲“Girls Just Want to Have Fun”，并在这次场合换成了“Ghouls Just Want to Have Fun”。

paras.en: - Chloe Bailey as Meg Griffin Chloe Bailey recognized Family Guy‘s most under-appreciated family member, Meg Griffin, by dressing up as the “Hot Meg” version of her for Halloween. The R&B singer showed off her figure in a pink strapless bra, denim skirt and boots, topping it off with Meg’s signature pink beanie and glasses. See Bailey as Meg here.
paras.zh: - 克洛伊·贝利 (Chloe Bailey) 饰演梅格·格里芬 (Meg Griffin) 克洛伊·贝利 (Chloe Bailey) 在万圣节装扮成“性感梅格”版的梅格·格里芬 (Meg Griffin)，认识到了《恶搞之家》中最不受重视的家庭成员梅格·格里芬 (Meg Griffin)。这位 R&B 歌手穿着粉色无肩带文胸、牛仔裙和靴子展示了自己的身材，并戴着梅格标志性的粉色无檐小便帽和眼镜。在这里将贝利视为梅格。

paras.en: - Owen Thiele & Benito Skinner as PinkPantheress & Zara Larsson Owen Thiele and Benito Skinner dressed up as one of pop music’s most dynamic duos in 2026: PinkPantheress and Zara Larsson, whose remix of “Stateside” reached No. 6 on the Hot 100 in March. The two friends recreated the pop stars’ plaid skirts and colorfully airbrushed baby tees from the “Stateside” music video for the look. See Thiele and Skinner as Pink and Larsson here.
paras.zh: - 欧文·蒂勒 (Owen Thiele) 和贝尼托·斯金纳 (Benito Skinner) 饰演 PinkPantheress 和扎拉·拉尔森 (Zara Larsson) 欧文·蒂勒 (Owen Thiele) 和贝尼托·斯金纳 (Benito Skinner) 装扮成 2026 年流行音乐最具活力的二人组之一：PinkPantheress 和 Zara Larsson，他们的混音版《Stateside》在 3 月份的 Hot 100 排行榜上排名第六。两位朋友重现了《Stateside》音乐录影带中流行歌星的格子裙和色彩缤纷的婴儿 T 恤。请在此处查看蒂勒和斯金纳饰演平克和拉尔森。

paras.en: - Travis Barker & Kourtney Kardashian as Vampires Travis Barker and Kourtney Kardashian have always loved gothic aesthetics, but at the 23rd birthday party for the Blink-182 drummer’s son, they went full vamp. The couple dressed up in all black and even added a touch of blood trickling down from the corners of their mouths to make it extra spooky. See Barker and Kardashian as vampires here.
paras.zh: - Travis Barker 和 Kourtney Kardashian 饰演吸血鬼 Travis Barker 和 Kourtney Kardashian 一直热爱哥特式美学，但在 Blink-182 鼓手儿子的 23 岁生日派对上，他们彻底变得疯狂。夫妻俩一身黑衣，嘴角还流淌着一抹血迹，显得格外阴森。在这里将巴克和卡戴珊视为吸血鬼。

paras.en: - Victoria Justice & Madison Grace as the Shining Twins Longtime Halloween lover Victoria Justice recruited her sister, Madison Grace, to dress up as the creepy twins from The Shining. “Come & play with us, Danny. Forever… and ever… and everrrrr,” she captioned an Instagram post showing off the look. The Victorious alum also popped out in a few different zombie-themed looks — including a zombie bride — as well as an elfish mushroom-inspired getup.
paras.zh: - 维多利亚·贾斯蒂斯 (Victoria Justice) 和麦迪逊·格蕾丝 (Madison Grace) 扮演《闪灵》中的双胞胎 万圣节的长期爱好者维多利亚·贾斯蒂斯 (Victoria Justice) 招募了她的妹妹麦迪逊·格雷斯 (Madison Grace) 来装扮成《闪灵》中令人毛骨悚然的双胞胎。 “丹尼，来和我们一起玩吧。永远……永远……永远……”她在 Instagram 上发了一条展示这一造型的帖子。这位胜利者还以几种不同的僵尸主题造型亮相——包括僵尸新娘——以及精灵蘑菇风格的装扮。

paras.en: - Janelle Monáe as Ghostess With the Mostess Janelle Monae started preparing for this year’s Wondaween by transforming herself into a green, decomposing zombie-like creature, which she dubbed “Hostess With the Mostess” in a video showing how she achieved the makeover. She pulled out all the stops for the look, topping it off with a swirly fake eye and blood spurting out of a faux wound in her neck. See Monae as “Hostess With the Mostess” here.
paras.zh: - 加奈儿·梦奈 (Janelle Monáe) 饰演“与最贵的女主人” 加奈尔·梦奈 (Janelle Monae) 开始为今年的 Wondaween 做准备，她把自己变成了一个绿色的、会腐烂的僵尸般的生物，她在一段视频中将其称为“与最贵的女主人”，展示了她如何实现这一转变。她使出了浑身解数，用一只旋转的假眼和脖子上的假伤口喷出的鲜血来完成这一造型。在这里将 Monae 视为“女主人与最美丽的人”。

paras.en: - Lizzo as Granny Seiko Lizzo tapped into her anime fandom for Halloween 2026, dressing up as Seiko Ayase from the anime Dandadan. As she does every year, the hitmaker went all out, this time donning a tall white wig and a massive faux bust. See her as Seiko here.
paras.zh: - Lizzo 饰演 Seiko 奶奶 Lizzo 在 2026 年万圣节进军了她的动漫迷圈，装扮成动漫《Dandadan》中的 Seiko Ayase。正如她每年所做的那样，这位热门歌手全力以赴，这一次戴上了高高的白色假发和巨大的人造半身像。在这里将她视为 Seiko。

paras.en: - Erika Jayne as Cruella Erika Jayne joined Lauper in channeling an iconic Disney villain for this year’s Hallow’s Eve, dressing up as Cruella de Vil from One Hundred and One Dalmatians. “Miserable, darling, as usual. Perfectly wretched,” the Real Housewives star captioned a video showing off the look, which came with a campy wig, spotted coat and retro cigarette holder. See Jayne as Cruella here.
paras.zh: - Erika Jayne 饰演 Cruella Erika Jayne 与 Lauper 一起在今年的万圣节前夕扮演迪士尼标志性反派角色，装扮成《一百零一只斑点狗》中的 Cruella de Vil。 “痛苦，亲爱的，像往常一样。非常可怜，”这位《真正的主妇》明星在一段展示这一造型的视频中写道，视频中还戴着一顶做作的假发，穿着斑点外套和复古烟嘴。在这里将杰恩视为克鲁拉。

paras.en: - Umi as Janet Jackson Umi dressed up — or should we say dressed down — to channel a bare-chested Janet Jackson on the cover of Rolling Stone in 1993. With no top and unbuttoned jeans, plus the iconic hands covering her bust from behind, the singer recreated Miss Jackson’s pose and sepia-toned photo for Halloween this year. See her as Jackson here.
paras.zh: - Umi 扮演珍妮·杰克逊 Umi 盛装打扮——或者我们应该说是便装——效仿 1993 年《滚石》杂志封面上赤裸上身的珍妮·杰克逊。这位歌手没有上衣，没有扣子，牛仔裤，加上标志性的双手从后面遮住胸部，这位歌手在今年的万圣节重现了杰克逊小姐的姿势和棕褐色色调的照片。在这里将她视为杰克逊。

paras.en: - Keke Palmer & Son Leo as Janet & Michael Jackson Keke Palmer and her 3-year-old son, Leo, honored both Janet and Michael Jackson for Halloween 2026, adorably recreating the iconic pop siblings’ “Scream” music video. Miss Jackson was a big fan, reposting a few of Palmer’s posts featuring the getup on Instagram Stories and writing, “HOW CUTE!” See Palmer and Leo as Janet and Michael Jackson here.
paras.zh: - Keke Palmer 和儿子 Leo 饰演珍妮特和迈克尔·杰克逊 Keke Palmer 和她 3 岁的儿子 Leo 在 2026 年万圣节向珍妮特和迈克尔·杰克逊致敬，可爱地重现了这对标志性流行兄弟的“Scream”音乐视频。杰克逊小姐是帕尔默的忠实粉丝，她在 Instagram Stories 上转发了帕尔默的一些帖子，并写道：“多可爱啊！”在这里将帕尔默和利奥视为珍妮特和迈克尔·杰克逊。

paras.en: - Summer Walker as Dr. Frank-N-Furter Summer Walker honored Tim Curry, who died in August, by dressing up as his iconic Rocky Horror Picture Show character Dr. Frank-N-Furter in a video lip-syncing to “Sweet Transvestite.” “R.I.P Tim Curry🥰 Dr. Frank & Furter 1975,” she wrote in her caption. See Walker as Curry here.
paras.zh: - 萨默·沃克 (Summer Walker) 饰演 Frank-N-Furter 博士 萨默·沃克 (Summer Walker) 为纪念 8 月去世的蒂姆·库里 (Tim Curry)，在一段与“甜蜜易装癖”视频对口型同步中，装扮成他在《洛基恐怖秀》中的标志性角色 Frank-N-Furter 博士。 “R.I.P Tim Curry🥰 Dr. Frank & Furter 1975，”她在标题中写道。在这里将沃克视为库里。

paras.en: - Lily Allen as Ticketing Seat Map Lily Allen poked fun at the chaotic live music industry by dressing as an online ticket-seller seat map. “Never beating the allegations. #bluedotfever,” she wrote on Instagram, captioning a series of photos showing off her white jumpsuit with a bunch of blue spots arranged in seating blocks. See Allen as a ticketing seat map here.
paras.zh: - 莉莉·艾伦 (Lily Allen) 饰演售票座位图 莉莉·艾伦 (Lily Allen) 打扮成在线售票员座位图，以此取笑混乱的现场音乐行业。她在 Instagram 上写道：“从来没有反驳过这些指控。#bluedotfever。”并配上一系列照片，展示了她的白色连身裤，座位区排列着一堆蓝色斑点。请在此处查看艾伦的票务座位图。

paras.en: - Lizzo as Dolly Parton Lizzo paid tribute to Dolly Parton, recreating the country icon’s look from the artwork for her 1973 hit single “Jolene.” The costume featured a skin-tight yellow floral jumpsuit and platinum blonde wig, with the singer-rapper sharing her admiration for the late country icon in a heartfelt Instagram post. See her as Parton here.
paras.zh: - Lizzo 饰演 Dolly Parton Lizzo 向 Dolly Parton 致敬，在她 1973 年的热门单曲“Jolene”的艺术作品中重现了这位乡村偶像的造型。这套服装以紧身黄色花卉连身裤和白金金色假发为特色，这位歌手兼说唱歌手在 Instagram 上发了一篇发自内心的帖子，分享了她对这位已故乡村音乐偶像的钦佩之情。在这里将她视为帕顿。

paras.en: - Justin & Hailey Bieber as Devil & Angel Justin and Hailey coordinated their Halloween costumes, with the Rhode founder dressing as an angel in a feathered white look complete with wings and a halo, while the pop superstar embraced his devilish side in an all-red outfit topped off with horns and a pointy tail. See Justin and Hailey as devil and angel here.
paras.zh: - 贾斯汀和海莉·比伯饰演魔鬼与天使 贾斯汀和海莉协调了他们的万圣节服装，罗德创始人穿着白色羽毛装扮，配有翅膀和光环，扮成天使，而这位流行巨星穿着全红色服装，上面有角和尖尾巴，拥抱着他邪恶的一面。在这里将贾斯汀和海莉视为魔鬼和天使。

paras.en: - KATSEYE as DC Characters KATSEYE brought some DC flair to Halloween this year, with the members dressing up as some of the franchise’s most recognizable characters. Yoonchae went full Harley Quinn, Megan transformed into Poison Ivy, Daniela suited up as Wonder Woman and Lara channeled Catwoman. “good luck picking a side,” the group captioned a fierce photo on Instagram. See KATSEYE as DC superheroes & villains here.
paras.zh: - KATSEYE 扮演 DC 角色 KATSEYE 为今年的万圣节带来了一些 DC 风格，成员们装扮成该系列最知名的角色。允彩变成了小丑女，梅根变成了毒藤女，丹妮拉变成了神奇女侠，劳拉变成了猫女。 “祝你选边站队好运，”该组织在 Instagram 上发布了一张激烈的照片。在这里将 KATSEYE 视为 DC 超级英雄和恶棍。

paras.en: - Slayyyter as Playmate of the Year from “Apocalypse Now” Slayyyter traveled back to the 1970s for Halloween this year, dressing up as Cynthia Wood’s Playmate of the Year character from Francis Ford Coppola’s 1979 film Apocalypse Now. In the Vietnam War film, Wood played the Playmate during the movie’s memorable USO show scene. “APOCALYPSE NOW, PLAYMATE OF THE YEAR!” the singer captioned a series of photos showing off her costume on Instagram. See Slayyyter as Playmate of the Year from Apocalypse Now here.
paras.zh: - 《现代启示录》中的年度玩伴 Slayyyter 今年万圣节回到 1970 年代，装扮成弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉 (Francis Ford Coppola) 1979 年电影《现代启示录》中辛西娅·伍德 (Cynthia Wood) 的年度玩伴角色。在越南战争电影中，伍德在电影中令人难忘的 USO 表演场景中扮演了玩伴。 “现代启示录，年度玩伴！”这位歌手在 Instagram 上发布了一系列展示她服装的照片。在这里查看《现代启示录》中的年度玩伴 Slayyyter。

paras.en: - Tate McRae as Catwoman Tate McRae leaned into her feline side this year, dressing up as Catwoman in a look inspired by Julie Newmar’s portrayal of the iconic character in the 1960s Batman television series. The “Greedy” singer put her own spin on the villain’s signature style with a sleek, all-black ensemble. See Tate McRae’s Catwoman costume here.
paras.zh: - 泰特·麦克雷 (Tate McRae) 饰演猫女 泰特·麦克雷 (Tate McRae) 今年向猫女倾斜，装扮成猫女，造型灵感源自朱莉·纽玛 (Julie Newmar) 在 1960 年代蝙蝠侠电视剧中扮演的标志性角色。这位“贪婪”歌手以时尚的全黑套装将自己的风格融入到反派的标志性风格中。在这里查看泰特·麦克雷的猫女服装。

paras.en: - Karol G as The Corpse Bride Karol G brought a gothic touch to this year’s Halloween celebrations by transforming into the titular character from Tim Burton’s 2005 animated classic Corpse Bride. The Colombian singer recreated the character’s signature look in a haunting blue-hued bridal ensemble. See Karol G as The Corpse Bride here.
paras.zh: - 卡罗尔·G 饰演“僵尸新娘” 卡罗尔·G 变身为蒂姆·波顿 2005 年经典动画《僵尸新娘》中的同名角色，为今年的万圣节庆祝活动增添了一抹哥特式的气息。这位哥伦比亚歌手以令人难以忘怀的蓝色新娘装再现了该角色的标志性造型。在这里查看 Karol G 饰演的僵尸新娘。

articles.title: Michael Mann Accidentally Shoots Himself at L.A. Gun Range
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Michael Mann was hospitalized on Saturday after accidentally shooting himself at a gun range in Los Angeles, The Hollywood Reporter has learned.
paras.zh: 据《好莱坞报道》获悉，迈克尔·曼周六在洛杉矶的一个射击场意外开枪自杀，入院治疗。

paras.en: “On Saturday, at a gun range, a weapon accidentally discharged while holstered resulting in a superficial injury to film director Michael Mann. He was treated and is being released,” a rep for the four-time Oscar-nominated filmmaker shared in a statement.
paras.zh: 这位四次获得奥斯卡提名的电影制片人的代表在一份声明中分享道：“周六，在射击场，一把武器在装在枪套中时意外走火，导致电影导演迈克尔·曼受了浅伤。他接受了治疗，正在被释放。”

paras.en: The Los Angeles Police Department said officers responded to The Range LA at around 4 p.m. for a call about shots fired. “Responding units’ investigation determined the shooting to be accidental. The subject was transported to a local hospital in stable condition,” authorities said.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶警察局表示，警方于下午 4 点左右对 The Range LA 作出回应。接到关于开枪的电话。当局表示：“响应单位的调查确定这起枪击事件是意外事件。受害者已被送往当地医院，情况稳定。”

paras.en: Sources told TMZ that Mann was apparently trying to holster his gun during target practice at a sanctioned gun range when the firearm went off. He was later taken to a local hospital for minor injuries. Mann has been an experienced target shooter for decades.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉 TMZ，曼恩显然是在一个经批准的射击场进行打靶练习时试图将枪收进枪套，这时枪械突然响起。他后来因轻伤被送往当地医院。几十年来，曼恩一直是一位经验丰富的射击手。

paras.en: Mann is currently in pre-production on Heat 2, which reportedly has Leonardo DiCaprio, Stephen Graham and Christian Bale attached to star. The film comes more than three decades after the 1995 crime drama Heat that starred Al Pacino, Robert De Niro, Val Kilmer and Jon Voight.
paras.zh: 曼恩目前正在筹备《热火2》，据报道莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥、史蒂芬·格雷厄姆和克里斯蒂安·贝尔将出演该片。这部电影是在 1995 年由阿尔·帕西诺、罗伯特·德尼罗、瓦尔·基默和乔恩·沃特主演的犯罪剧《盗火线》上映三十多年前拍摄的。

paras.en: He’s also best known for directing 1981’s Thief, 1999’s The Insider, 2001’s Ali, 2004’s Collateral, 2006’s Miami Vice, 2009’s Public Enemies and 2023’s Ferrari, among others. Throughout his career, he’s received four Academy Award nominations, including best director, best picture and best adapted screenplay for The Insider, and best picture for 2005’s The Aviator.
paras.zh: 他还因执导 1981 年的《神偷》、1999 年的《局内人》、2001 年的《阿里》、2004 年的《借刀杀人》、2006 年的《迈阿密风云》、2009 年的《公敌》和 2023 年的《法拉利》等而闻名。在他的整个职业生涯中，他获得了四项奥斯卡奖提名，包括《局内人》的最佳导演、最佳影片和最佳改编剧本提名，以及 2005 年《飞行者》的最佳影片提名。

articles.title: ‘You Can See Everything,’ ‘Clayface’ Fighting for No. 1 in Quiet Halloween Weekend
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: A24’s Elizabeth Holmes documentary You Can See Everything, which includes a memorable discussion about the classic comedy routine “Who’s on First,” sparked questions about whether the movie itself could take first place over Clayface as the two films battled at the box office during a subdued Halloween weekend.
paras.zh: A24 的伊丽莎白·福尔摩斯纪录片《你可以看到一切》，其中包括对经典喜剧套路“谁在第一”的令人难忘的讨论，引发了人们的疑问，即电影本身是否可以超越《粘土脸》，因为两部电影在万圣节周末的票房上展开了激烈的较量。

paras.en: Sunday figures show the two movies still neck and neck for the top spot domestically, with directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim‘s You Can See Everything looking like the early winner at $10.6 million in its third weekend to bring its North American cume to $63.8 million. Currently playing in 3,243 North American locations, the Oscar-buzzed documentary eyes its first No. 1 finish. It looks to decline around 43 percent for the weekend that saw the studios avoid releasing new titles as Halloween fell on a Saturday.
paras.zh: 周日的数据显示，这两部电影在国内票房榜上仍不相上下，导演内森·菲尔德和兰斯·奥本海姆的《你可以看到一切》看起来是早期获胜者，在第三周末获得 1,060 万美元的票房，北美票房达到 6,380 万美元。这部备受奥斯卡好评的纪录片目前在北美 3,243 个地点上映，有望首次获得第一名。由于万圣节恰逢周六，工作室避免发布新游戏，周末的票房收入似乎下降了 43% 左右。

paras.en: If this holds, the three-hour You Can See Everything would follow previous features True Grit, Argo and 1917 as films that hit No. 1 in their third frames. Despite the meager overall turnout for this weekend’s moviegoing, the domestic box office’s 2026 take of $8.46 billion still puts it around 20 percent ahead of last year’s total sum to this point, according to Rentrak.
paras.zh: 如果这种情况成立，那么时长三小时的《你可以看到一切》将继《大地惊雷》、《逃离德黑兰》和《1917》之后，成为在第三部电影中排名第一的电影。 Rentrak 的数据显示，尽管本周末的总体观影人数微乎其微，但 2026 年国内票房收入为 84.6 亿美元，仍比去年总票房高出 20% 左右。

paras.en: Just behind You Can See Everything for the time being is Clayface, as filmmaker James Watkins’ body horror feature looks to gross around $10.4 million in its sophomore frame for a two-week North American sum of $44.1 million. Tom Rhys Harries and Naomi Ackie star in the $44 million-budgeted Warner Bros. release that marks DC Studios‘ third theatrical title for bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran after 2025’s Superman and this summer’s underperforming Supergirl. Clayface looks to decline around 56 percent for the weekend.
paras.zh: 目前排在《你可以看到一切》之后的是《泥脸》，电影制片人詹姆斯·沃特金斯的人体恐怖片在第二部上映时预计票房约为 1,040 万美元，北美两周票房为 4,410 万美元。汤姆·里斯·哈里斯 (Tom Rhys Harries) 和娜奥米·阿基 (Naomi Ackie) 主演了华纳兄弟制作的这部耗资 4400 万美元的电影，这是继 2025 年的《超人》和今年夏天表现不佳的《女超人》之后，DC 工作室为老板詹姆斯·古恩 (James Gunn) 和彼得·萨夫兰 (Peter Safran) 推出的第三部影院作品。 Clayface 周末的跌幅约为 56%。

paras.en: Overall, this weekend is headed for one of the lowest domestic totals of the year with $55.6 million, down a frightening 42.1 percent from last weekend, per Rentrak. This still marks a roughly 4.2 percent uptick over the $49 million collected from the equivalent weekend in 2025. Last year, Halloween fell on Friday as Black Phone 2 led the frame with $8.3 million in its third weekend.
paras.zh: 总体而言，根据 Rentrak 的数据，本周末的国内​​总金额将是今年最低的之一，为 5560 万美元，比上周末下降了 42.1%。这仍然比 2025 年同期周末的 4900 万美元收入增长了约 4.2%。去年万圣节恰逢周五，《黑手机 2》在第三个周末以 830 万美元的收入领先。

paras.en: “Historical challenges can spook studios away from launching a major film into the marketplace,” Rentrak’s Paul Dergarabedian tells The Hollywood Reporter of competition from parties and trick-or-treating on moviegoing’s biggest day of the weekend. He points out that the lack of a splashy opener “limits the opportunity for a major new release to give October a big closing boost. [But] the broader horror picture remains remarkable. A quieter Halloween weekend can coexist with an exceptionally strong year for the genre.”
paras.zh: Rentrak 的保罗·德加拉贝迪安 (Paul Dergarabedian) 向《好莱坞报道》表示，“历史性的挑战可能会吓跑制片厂，让他们不敢将一部大片推向市场。”他指出，缺乏引人注目的开场“限制了重大新片上映给十月带来巨大收官提振的机会。[但是]更广泛的恐怖图景仍然引人注目。安静的万圣节周末可以与该类型异常强劲的一年共存。”

paras.en: In third place is Laika‘s stop-motion animated feature Wildwood, which earned around $7.5 million in its second weekend to bring its domestic sum to $25.8 million. Carey Mulligan, Peyton Elizabeth Lee and Jacob Tremblay lead the voice cast for director Travis Knight’s movie that eyes an impressive decline of around 38 percent and was likely dinged by families’ weekend attention focusing away from cinemas. Wildwood has generated Oscar buzz and carries a 99 percent critics approval rating from Rotten Tomatoes, but it will need to continue to show legs, given its hefty reported production budget of $100 million.
paras.zh: 排在第三位的是莱卡的定格动画长片《怀尔德伍德》，该片在第二个周末就获得了约 750 万美元的票房收入，使其国内票房达到了 2580 万美元。由凯里·穆里根、佩顿·伊丽莎白·李和雅各布·特伦布莱领衔的配音演员为特拉维斯·奈特导演的电影预计下降了约 38%，令人印象深刻，这可能是由于周末家庭注意力从电影院转移而造成的。 《怀尔德伍德》在奥斯卡上引起了轰动，并在烂番茄上获得了 99% 的影评人支持率，但鉴于据报道其制作预算高达 1 亿美元，它还需要继续大展拳脚。

paras.en: Registering a similarly enviable hold with a decline around 28 percent is Black Bear’s Wicker, as the romantic fantasy grossed $4.1 million from 2,374 North American theaters for a domestic total of $13.2 million after its second weekend. Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgard star in directors Eleanor Wilson and Alex Huston Fischer’s movie about a woman in a quiet village who gets a wicker husband. It holds a strong 94 Rotten Tomatoes score from critics.
paras.zh: 《黑熊的柳条》的票房表现也同样令人羡慕，跌幅约为 28%，这部浪漫奇幻片在北美 2,374 家影院上映后票房收入为 410 万美元，国内总票房为 1,320 万美元。奥利维亚·科尔曼和亚历山大·斯卡斯加德主演了导演埃莉诺·威尔逊和亚历克斯·休斯顿·费舍尔的电影，讲述了一个安静村庄里的女人嫁给了一个柳条丈夫的故事。它在烂番茄上获得了 94 分的高分。

paras.en: Closing out the top five is Paramount and Legendary’s Street Fighter, picking up $3.2 million in its third weekend as its domestic cume reaches $53 million in its third weekend. Starring Noah Centineo and Andrew Koji, director Kitao Sakurai’s adaptation of the Capcom video game added $3.2 million internationally as the global total stands at $91.9 million for the $82 million-budgeted feature.
paras.zh: 排在前五名的是派拉蒙影业和传奇影业出品的《街头霸王》，该片在第三周末的票房收入为 320 万美元，国内票房则达到了 5300 万美元。由诺亚·琴蒂内奥 (Noah Centineo) 和安德鲁·小司 (Andrew Koji) 主演、导演樱井北雄改编的这部由 Capcom 电子游戏改编的作品在国际上斩获了 320 万美元的票房，这部预算为 8,200 万美元的电影的全球总票房为 9,190 万美元。

paras.en: Likely landing in seventh place is Sony’s Resident Evil, which crossed $400 million at the global box office in its seventh weekend of release. Its projected $2.5 million domestically for the frame will bring the North American total to $157.3 million for director Zach Cregger’s Austin Abrams-led adaptation of the video game.
paras.zh: 排名第七的可能是索尼的《生化危机》，该片在上映第七周末的全球票房就突破了 4 亿美元。该游戏的国内票房预计为 250 万美元，而由导演扎克·克雷格 (Zach Cregger) 执导、奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯 (Austin Abrams) 领衔改编的游戏在北美的总票房将达到 1.573 亿美元。

paras.en: Despite the slow weekend, analysts see the box office as likely to pick up dramatically as the 2026 holiday corridor approaches. Remaining high-profile titles for 2026 include The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, Avengers: Doomsday, Dune: Part Three and more.
paras.zh: 尽管周末缓慢，但分析师认为，随着 2026 年假期走廊的临近，票房可能会大幅回升。 2026 年剩下的备受瞩目的游戏包括《饥饿游戏：收割日出》、《复仇者联盟：世界末日》、《沙丘：第三部分》等。

paras.en: “This is the first time since the pandemic that Halloween has landed on a Saturday, and studios are wise to avoid competing with parties or trick-or-treating events, on top of the usual packed football schedule in the States this time of year,” Fandango director of analytics and Box Office Theory founder Shawn Robbins tells THR. He notes that such a gap can precede a busy stretch, which is likely this year “as holiday moviegoing picks up, and the cadence of tentpole releases resumes, crescendoing with a December that may be one for movie theater record books and cap off a strong year for the industry.”
paras.zh: Fandango 分析总监兼 Box Office Theory 创始人肖恩·罗宾斯 (Shawn Robbins) 告诉《好莱坞报道》：“这是自大流行以来万圣节第一次出现在周六，除了美国每年这个时候通常排满的足球赛程之外，电影公司明智的做法是避免与派对或“不给糖就捣蛋”活动竞争。”他指出，这样的差距可能会在繁忙的一段时间之前出现，今年很可能会出现这种情况，“随着假期观影人数的增加，热门电影上映的节奏恢复，12 月可能会创下电影院纪录，并为该行业强劲的一年画上句号。”

articles.title: ‘O.J.’s Accomplice’ Has Its Own ‘The Jinx’ Hot Mic Moment
articles.author: Anthony Maglio

paras.en: OK, so we don’t quite get a Bob-Durst-at-the-urinal confession out of new Peacock documentary series OJ’s Accomplice, but directors Ari Mark (Amy Bradley Is Missing) and Sumit David (Diddy: The Making of a Bad Boy) captured an interesting hot-mic moment of their own during production.
paras.zh: 好吧，我们并没有从新孔雀系列纪录片《OJ 的同谋》中看到鲍勃·德斯特在小便池里的忏悔，但导演阿里·马克（《艾米·布拉德利失踪》）和苏米特·大卫（《老爹：坏小子的制作》）在制作过程中捕捉到了他们自己的一个有趣的热麦克风时刻。

paras.en: The two-part docuseries resurfaces the somewhat forgotten alternative theory that O.J. Simpson was aided by another man in the 1994 slayings of the former football star’s ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and Ronald Goldman. (Simpson was acquitted in the double homicide, but counterpoint: be serious.) The front-running suspect in that alt theory is now Joey Ippolito, a former drug smuggler and friend of Simpson’s. Simpson and Ippolito are both deceased.
paras.zh: 这部由两部分组成的系列纪录片重新浮现了 O.J. 1994 年，辛普森在另一名男子的帮助下杀害了这位前足球明星的前妻妮可·布朗·辛普森和罗纳德·戈德曼。 （辛普森在双重杀人案中被无罪释放，但相反：严肃点。）另类理论中的领先嫌疑人现在是乔伊·伊波利托（Joey Ippolito），他是前毒品走私犯，也是辛普森的朋友。辛普森和伊波利托均已去世。

paras.en: One of the key characters — and “characters” is definitely the right term for the participants in this particular project — in OJ’s Accomplice is Charlie Ehrlich, another friend of Simpson’s and another ex-con. Ehrlich sat for Ample Entertainment’s cameras at the strip club he manages, The Peppermint Hippo. As the conversation wrapped, David told Ehrlich that production would need to “get some B-roll,” and then both men headed to the bar. Ehrlich was still mic’d up — and now loosened up.
paras.zh: 《OJ 的同谋》中的关键人物之一——“人物”对于这个特定项目的参与者来说绝对是正确的术语——是查理·埃利希 (Charlie Ehrlich)，他是辛普森的另一位朋友，也是另一位前科犯。埃利希在他经营的脱衣舞俱乐部“薄荷河马”中坐在 Ample Entertainment 的镜头前。谈话结束后，大卫告诉埃利希，制作团队需要“获取一些幕后花絮”，然后两人前往酒吧。埃利希仍然戴着麦克风——现在放松了。

paras.en: “You didn’t bring it up, so I’m not going to bring it up,” Ehrlich, who was still wearing a microphone pack and within camera’s frame, said to David from his stool.
paras.zh: “你没有提出来，所以我也不会提出来，”埃利希仍然戴着麦克风包，在镜头内，坐在凳子上对大卫说道。

paras.en: “But yeah. I was very good friends with his brother Lou (Ippolito),” Ehrlich continued. “Do you know what Lou told me? He told me that a month before Joey died, he took him to Italy — took Joe to Italy. Joe admitted that he was involved [in the Simpson/Goldman murders].”
paras.zh: “但是，是的。我和他的兄弟卢（伊波利托）是非常好的朋友，”埃利希继续说道。 “你知道卢告诉我什么吗？他告诉我，乔伊去世前一个月，他带他去了意大利——带乔去了意大利。乔承认他参与了[辛普森/高盛谋杀案]。”

paras.en: The Hollywood Reporter asked Mark if Ehrlich was aware that his audio was still being captured.
paras.zh: 《好莱坞报道》询问马克，埃利希是否知道他的音频仍在被捕获。

paras.en: “He knew he was mic’d up,” Mark told The Hollywood Reporter. “What happens quite often is, you know, folks are mic’d up and get comfortable. I don’t think he had forgotten that he was mic’d up necessarily, but I think he probably started speaking more casually.”
paras.zh: “他知道自己被麦克风覆盖了，”马克告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “经常发生的情况是，你知道，人们都打开了麦克风并感到舒服。我认为他并没有忘记他一定是打开了麦克风，但我认为他可能开始更加随意地说话。”

paras.en: Mark says he also believes Ehrlich knew the cameras were still rolling.
paras.zh: 马克说，他还相信埃利希知道摄像机仍在转动。

paras.en: David was not the first person to whom Ehrlich relayed Lou Ippolito’s story. For starters, Mark said Lou Ippolito told production the same story — just not on camera. (Ample Entertainment did capture some footage of Lou Ippolito, but he asked them to not use it, Mark told THR.)
paras.zh: 大卫并不是埃利希第一个向他讲述卢·伊波利托故事的人。首先，马克说卢·伊波利托向制作组讲述了同样的故事——只是不是在镜头前。 （马克告诉《好莱坞报道》，Ample Entertainment 确实拍摄了卢·伊波利托的一些镜头，但他要求他们不要使用它。）

paras.en: But Ehrlich also has a big mouth, if you didn’t get that sense by now.
paras.zh: 但埃利希也有一张大嘴，如果你现在还没有意识到的话。

paras.en: “It was like a deathbed admission. Louie told Charlie, Charlie told me,” Ehrlich’s friend Joe Spitaleri says in a separate OJ’s Accomplice interview. “I was scared to bring it up because Charlie asked me not to.”
paras.zh: “这就像临终前的承认。路易告诉了查理，查理也告诉了我，”埃利希的朋友乔·斯皮塔勒里在另一次《OJ’s Concomplice》采访中说道。 “我不敢提起这件事，因为查理要求我不要提起。”

paras.en: Not everyone is looking forward to OJ’s Accomplice, which premieres both of its episodes Sunday morning on Peacock.
paras.zh: 并不是所有人都期待《OJ 的同谋》，该剧周日上午在 Peacock 频道首播了两集。

paras.en: In an email sent earlier this month to THR (and other news outlets), Joey Ippolito’s widow Nicole Ippolito ripped OJ’s Accomplice as a “woefully misguided project.”
paras.zh: 在本月早些时候发送给 THR（和其他新闻媒体）的一封电子邮件中，乔伊·伊波利托 (Joey Ippolito) 的遗孀妮可·伊波利托 (Nicole Ippolito) 痛斥 OJ 的《同谋》是一个“可悲的误导性项目”。

paras.en: “Actual vetted facts prove this to be another hoax feeding off of the those who are not here to defend themselves,” Nicole Ippolito wrote, calling the docuseries’ sources “scam artists” and “drug addicts” participating as a “money grab.”
paras.zh: 妮可·伊波利托写道：“经过实际审查的事实证明，这是另一个骗局，由那些不来这里为自己辩护的人提供。”她称该系列纪录片的来源是“诈骗艺术家”和“吸毒成瘾者”，参与其中是为了“抢钱”。

paras.en: Mark tells THR Ehrlich was only paid for the rights for archival photographs and materials, which is a standard arrangement for documentaries. He was not paid for an interview.
paras.zh: 马克告诉《THR Ehrlich》，他只获得了档案照片和材料的版权费，这是纪录片的标准安排。他没有获得采访报酬。

paras.en: THR attempted to reach Nicole Ippolito for comment.
paras.zh: 《好莱坞报道》试图联系 Nicole Ippolito 征求意见。

paras.en: At the time of Nicole Ippolito’s protest, OJ’s Accomplice was set for a December release. This past Tuesday, plans were changed.
paras.zh: 在妮可·伊波利托 (Nicole Ippolito) 提出抗议之际，《OJ’s Accomplice》原定于 12 月上映。上周二，计划发生了变化。

paras.en: “We wanted to make sure this documentary remained a part of the timely news cycle conversation,” a Peacock rep told THR, referring (primarily) to a New York Times article that covers the same theory using much of the same source material.
paras.zh: “我们希望确保这部纪录片仍然是及时新闻周期对话的一部分，”一位孔雀代表告诉《好莱坞报道》，他指的是《纽约时报》的一篇文章，该文章使用大部分相同的来源材料涵盖了相同的理论。

paras.en: The timing of the article wasn’t great for OJ’s Accomplice, though it does lend some credence to its newsworthiness. THR asked Mark if getting scooped like that was “a bummer.”
paras.zh: 这篇文章发表的时机对 OJ 的同谋来说并不好，尽管它确实为其新闻价值提供了一些可信度。 《好莱坞报道》问马克，像这样被独家报道是否“令人沮丧”。

paras.en: “Look, I mean, I’m always juggling my ego against the success of a show, and I’ve definitely over the years gotten pretty used to — and I’m saying this not with bitterness — but gotten pretty used to not getting credited for some hard work,” he said. “It’s not a new thing for me. So, you know, I think the bummer was not being able to piggyback the way that I would like off the credibility that the New York Times brings to this.”
paras.zh: “听着，我的意思是，我总是在自我意识和节目的成功之间权衡，这些年来我肯定已经习惯了——我这么说并不是带着痛苦——但已经习惯了不因某些努力工作而受到赞扬，”他说。 “这对我来说不是什么新鲜事。所以，你知道，我认为令人遗憾的是未能以我希望的方式利用《纽约时报》为此带来的可信度。”

paras.en: Mark says he helped with the NYT piece. He would have appreciated a bit more cooperation on a coordinated release.
paras.zh: 马克说他帮助完成了《纽约时报》的这篇文章。他希望在协调发布方面能有更多合作。

paras.en: THR asked Mark what he personally believes happened on the evening of June 12, 1994. He definitely believes Simpson was the main guy who committed the murders, which Mark feels were more “premeditated” than most people think. For any “objective” person, he added, it is more “logical” than not to believe that Simpson had a helper on the scene.
paras.zh: 《THR》询问马克，他个人认为 1994 年 6 月 12 日晚上发生了什么。他确信辛普森是谋杀案的主犯，而马克认为这比大多数人想象的更有“预谋”。他补充说，对于任何“客观”的人来说，相信辛普森在现场有帮手比不相信更“合乎逻辑”。

paras.en: OJ’s Accomplice is now available to stream on Peacock.
paras.zh: 《OJ 的同谋》现已在 Peacock 上播出。

articles.title: Alaska Sen. Sullivan says he'll accept election results, slams Peltola campaign’s reported recruitment of 2nd Sullivan

paras.en: Alaska Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan said Sunday he would accept the results of Tuesday's midterm elections, while slamming Democratic candidate Mary Peltola's campaign for reportedly recruiting Dan J. Sullivan to run as a spoiler.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加州共和党参议员丹·沙利文周日表示，他将接受周二中期选举的结果，同时猛烈抨击民主党候选人玛丽·佩尔托拉的竞选活动，据报道招募丹·沙利文作为搅局者。

paras.en: "No, I'm going to accept the election results," Sullivan said on CNN's "State of the Union" when asked whether he would accept the results only if he wins. President Donald Trump's Department of Justice has sued Alaska, demanding the state not certify the election if the incumbent Republican loses.
paras.zh: “不，我会接受选举结果，”沙利文在美​​国有线电视新闻网（CNN）的“国情咨文”节目中被问及是否只有获胜才会接受结果时说道。唐纳德·特朗普总统的司法部已起诉阿拉斯加州，要求如果现任共和党人失败，该州不得批准选举。

paras.en: The lawsuit cites theoretical voter confusion over the appearance of the second Sullivan on the ballot, which DOJ says could siphon votes away from the incumbent Republican Sullivan and benefit Peltola. Alaska's Senate race is rated as a "toss-up" by the nonpartisan Cook Political Report with Amy Walter, and Peltola holds a slight edge in the polling average compiled by FiftyPlusOne.
paras.zh: 该诉讼称，理论上选民对第二个沙利文出现在选票上感到困惑，司法部表示，这可能会从现任共和党人沙利文手中夺走选票，并使佩尔托拉受益。阿拉斯加州的参议员竞选被无党派的库克政治报告和艾米·沃尔特评为“势均力敌”，而佩尔托拉在 FiftyPlusOne 编制的民调平均值中略有优势。

paras.en: Peltola has repeatedly denied any involvement with the second Sullivan. However, The New York Times reported last week that her campaign was directly involved with recruiting Dan J. Sullivan, a retired schoolteacher, to run as a spoiler.
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉一再否认与第二个沙利文有任何关系。然而，《纽约时报》上周报道称，她的竞选活动直接参与了招募退休教师丹·J·沙利文(Dan J. Sullivan)作为搅局者参选。

paras.en: Ballot-stacking is typically not illegal, and both parties have used it in past elections. Still, Alaska Gov. Mike Dunleavy ordered a criminal investigation into the alleged scheme. Alaska's Supreme Court upheld Dan J. Sullivan's place on the ballot during an earlier legal challenge.
paras.zh: 堆积选票通常并不违法，双方在过去的选举中都曾使用过这种做法。尽管如此，阿拉斯加州长迈克·邓利维仍下令对涉嫌的计划进行刑事调查。阿拉斯加最高法院在早些时候的法律挑战中维持了丹·J·沙利文的投票地位。

paras.en: Sullivan on CNN said that the Times report shows Peltola's campaign, along with the Democratic Senate campaign arm, "recognizing they couldn't run on their record, so they had to cheat."
paras.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网的沙利文表示，《泰晤士报》的报道显示，佩尔托拉的竞选团队以及民主党参议院竞选部门“认识到他们无法按照自己的记录参选，所以他们不得不作弊。”

paras.en: "I think a lot of Alaskans, even Democrats, are thinking she is not fit for office; she's continually lying to the Alaskan people, and I guarantee you she's lying right now," Sullivan said.
paras.zh: 沙利文说：“我认为很多阿拉斯加人，甚至民主党人，都认为她不适合担任公职；她不断地对阿拉斯加人民撒谎，我向你们保证她现在就在撒谎。”

paras.en: Peltola denied any knowledge of the alleged scheme to draft a second Sullivan in an interview with KTUU on Friday.
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉在周五接受 KTUU 采访时否认对所谓的起草第二个沙利文计划有任何了解。

paras.en: "I honestly have no idea," Peltola said. "This is offensive to me on a number of different levels; first of all, this is Alaska, we're not in the business of tricking each other up here."
paras.zh: “老实说，我不知道，”佩尔托拉说。 “这在很多方面都冒犯了我；首先，这是阿拉斯加，我们不是要在这里互相欺骗。”

paras.en: "I've won statewide before, on my own merits, without any tricks involved; I know I can win again," she said.
paras.zh: “我以前曾在全州范围内获胜，凭借我自己的优点，没有任何技巧；我知道我可以再次获胜，”她说。

paras.en: The stakes of the Alaska race are high. Democrats need to flip four seats while holding all currently Democratic seats to win a Senate majority. Alaska has emerged as a top opportunity for one of those flips.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加比赛的风险很高。民主党需要在保持目前所有民主党席位的同时翻转四个席位才能赢得参议院多数席位。阿拉斯加已成为实现这些转变的最佳机会之一。

paras.en: The midterms will determine which party controls Congress for the remainder of Trump's term in the White House.
paras.zh: 中期选举将决定哪个政党在特朗普剩余的白宫任期内控制国会。

articles.title: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy has stroke and is in the hospital, office says

paras.en: Sen. Chris Murphy, a Connecticut Democrat, was hospitalized Saturday after suffering a stroke at his son's hockey game, his office announced on Sunday.
paras.zh: 康涅狄格州民主党参议员克里斯·墨菲的办公室周日宣布，他在儿子的曲棍球比赛中中风，周六住院。

paras.en: Murphy is "awake and alert," according to a statement from his chief of staff Allison Herwitt.
paras.zh: 墨菲的幕僚长艾莉森·赫威特在一份声明中表示，墨菲“清醒且警觉”。

paras.en: "Yesterday afternoon, Senator Murphy started experiencing numbness in his arm while at his son's hockey game. He was taken to a local hospital, where it was discovered he had experienced a stroke. He was transferred to Johns Hopkins for further monitoring and is responding well to treatment," Herwitt said.
paras.zh: 赫威特说：“昨天下午，墨菲参议员在儿子的曲棍球比赛中开始感到手臂麻木。他被送往当地一家医院，在那里发现他中风了。他被转移到约翰·霍普金斯大学接受进一步监测，并且对治疗反应良好。”

paras.en: "The doctors are encouraged by his progress," Herwitt said. "We are optimistic he will make a full recovery."
paras.zh: “医生们对他的进步感到鼓舞，”赫维特说。 “我们对他将完全康复感到乐观。”

paras.en: Murphy, who came to the Senate in 2013, is not up for reelection on Tuesday, but he's been crisscrossing the country campaigning for Democratic candidates, with recent stops in Michigan, Minnesota and Florida. He was due in New Hampshire on Sunday to campaign with Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas.
paras.zh: 墨菲于 2013 年进入参议院，周二不会竞选连任，但他一直在全国各地为民主党候选人竞选，最近去了密歇根州、明尼苏达州和佛罗里达州。他原定于周日在新罕布什尔州与民主党众议员克里斯·帕帕斯一起竞选。

paras.en: He's seen as a potential 2028 presidential candidate and is a prolific Democratic fundraiser.
paras.zh: 他被视为潜在的 2028 年总统候选人，也是一位多产的民主党筹款人。

paras.en: This story is developing. Please refresh for updates.
paras.zh: 这个故事正在发展。请刷新以获取更新。

articles.title: Democratic Rep. Stevens endorses Rogers over El-Sayed in Michigan Senate election

paras.en: Michigan Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens, in a stunning move, endorsed Republican Senate nominee Mike Rogers over Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday.
paras.zh: 密歇根州民主党众议员海莉·史蒂文斯周日支持共和党参议院候选人迈克·罗杰斯，而不是民主党候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德，此举令人震惊。

paras.en: Stevens had lost the primary for Democratic nomination to El-Sayed earlier this year.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，史蒂文斯在民主党提名初选中输给了埃尔-赛义德。

paras.en: Her endorsement of Rogers came after days of rising tension with El-Sayed and his campaign over an ad by a political action committee.
paras.zh: 她对罗杰斯的支持是在与埃尔赛义德及其竞选团队因政治行动委员会的一则广告而关系紧张几天后做出的。

paras.en: "Hey Michigan, as you may have seen, our Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate, Abdul, said I'm no longer welcome in his campaign, and I should stay away, and he's right," Stevens said in a video statement on X.
paras.zh: 史蒂文斯在 X 上的视频声明中说：“嘿，密歇根州，正如你可能已经看到的，我们的美国参议院民主党候选人阿卜杜勒说，他不再欢迎我参加他的竞选活动，我应该远离，他是对的。”

paras.en: "And that's why I am endorsing Mike Rogers for the United States Senate today," she said.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我今天支持迈克·罗杰斯进入美国参议院，”她说。

paras.en: "I don't belong in Abdul's campaign. I do not stand with Hasan Piker, who gets trafficked on our college campuses," said Stevens.
paras.zh: “我不属于阿卜杜勒的竞选活动。我不支持哈桑·派克，他在我们的大学校园里被贩卖，”史蒂文斯说。

paras.en: Piker is a controversial political commentator who has campaigned with El-Sayed.
paras.zh: 派克是一位颇具争议的政治评论员，曾与埃尔-赛义德一起竞选。

paras.en: "I'm sorry people are upset," Stevens told reporters at a press conference in Detroit as she stood with Rogers, with whom she had attended church Sunday morning.
paras.zh: “我很抱歉人们感到不安，”史蒂文斯在底特律举行的新闻发布会上对记者说，她与罗杰斯站在一起，周日早上她和罗杰斯一起去教堂。

paras.en: Rogers and El-Sayed are vying for a seat that is set to become vacant due to Democratic Sen. Gary Peters' decision not to seek re-election.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯和埃尔-赛义德正在争夺一个因民主党参议员加里·彼得斯决定不寻求连任而空缺的席位。
